raw.excerpt: Remote hire - ideally either UK or TurkeyAt Bolt Insight, we build research technology that gives FMCG and CPG brands faster, deeper, and more actionable consumer insight.
raw.description:
Remote hire - ideally either UK or Turkey

At Bolt Insight, we build research technology that gives FMCG and CPG brands faster, deeper, and more actionable consumer insight. Our platform combines AI-powered qualitative and quantitative research and we need a Research Director who can bring rigour, curiosity, and strong quantitative craft to everything we do.

This is a hands-on role with real client exposure. You'll lead projects end-to-end, mentor junior researchers, and help push the boundaries of what AI-assisted research can deliver. If you have a strong quant foundation, love translating data into compelling stories, and thrive in a fast-moving environment, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Lead projects end-to-end

  • Own the full project lifecycle for global clients from methodology design and scoping through to fieldwork, analysis, and final reporting.

  • Work closely with junior Research Executives, guiding their execution, output quality, and professional development.

  • Ensure clear, proactive communication with all stakeholders, delivering strategic insights and actionable recommendations on time.

Own the client relationship

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your client portfolio, building trust and tailoring research solutions to their specific needs.

  • Lead client calls, contribute to proposals, and follow through on every project commitment.

  • Maintain strong ongoing relationships that drive repeat engagement and client satisfaction.

Deliver rigorous quantitative research

  • Design and execute complex quantitative studies including MaxDiff, conjoint, regression, factor analysis, and segmentation independently and to a high standard.

  • Work fluently in SPSS and Excel (advanced level), including chart production, cross-tabulation, and statistical reporting.

  • Manage Quant AI (BoltQ) projects end-to-end: questionnaire design, logic setup, automated analysis, and report storytelling.

  • Ensure all quant outputs are accurate, clearly structured, and meet client expectations for rigour and insight depth.

Craft strong research narratives

  • Produce output decks that combine analytical clarity with compelling storytelling — findings that clients can act on, not just read.

  • Translate complex quantitative outputs into clear strategic implications for non-technical audiences.

  • Quality-assure AI-generated outputs and ensure all deliverables meet Bolt Insight's standards.

Drive innovation and process improvement

  • Contribute to the development of BoltChatAI and BoltQ by gathering client feedback and identifying improvement opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to enhance AI-driven research capabilities.

  • Develop and refine internal workflows to improve research efficiency and quality across the team.

Develop the team

  • Mentor and train junior researchers in both traditional and AI-assisted methodologies.

  • Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, and professional growth within the research team.

  • Provide input on team expansion and recruitment where needed.

What We're Looking For

Strong quantitative foundation — You've independently delivered complex quant projects — MaxDiff, conjoint, regression, factor analysis, segmentation — and you're comfortable with SPSS and advanced Excel. This isn't a nice to have; it's the core of the role.

End-to-end project ownership — You take full responsibility for delivery, from brief to debrief, and you don't need to be chased to keep things moving.

Client-facing confidence — You're comfortable leading client calls and building relationships. You listen carefully, communicate clearly, and know when to push back constructively.

Storytelling through data — You can turn a MaxDiff output or a regression model into a clear, compelling narrative that actually influences decisions.

AI research curiosity — You're open to — ideally already experienced with — AI-powered research tools. You understand their value and their limits.

Team player and mentor — You enjoy bringing junior colleagues on, sharing what you know, and building team capability over time.

A note on quantitative depth

We'll explore your quant experience directly in the interview process — not to catch you out, but because it matters for this role. We're looking for someone who has genuinely delivered advanced techniques (MaxDiff, conjoint, segmentation) independently, not just observed them. If there are areas where you'd benefit from development, be upfront — we invest in our people and we'd rather know where we can help than find gaps later.

Why Work for Bolt Insight?

At Bolt Insight, we’re a vibrant and growing start-up mentality business with a passionate team that thrives on innovation and collaboration. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • Remote working and the flexibility to work in a nomadic way – Enjoy the best of both worlds, balancing work and life your way.

  • Flexible working environment – We trust you to manage your time and work in a way that suits you best.

  • Private Medical Insurance - Your health and well-being are important to us, and we’ve got you covered.

  • Business referral bonus – If you know someone who’s a great fit for the team, we’ll reward you for it!

  • Employee referral bonus – You get the chance to shape our team and be rewarded for bringing great people onboard.

  • Virtual or local team gatherings – Whether online or in person, we love to connect and celebrate our successes together.

  • In-house recognition awards – We celebrate our ‘lightning bolts’ (those who go above and beyond) and show our appreciation for hard work!

  • Annual Bonus System – If the company meets its targets, you’ll receive a bonus payment of up to two months’ salary! We win together.

At Bolt, curiosity, creativity and passion matter most. If you’re excited about shaping the future of research and contributing to a culture built on innovation and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

Bolt Insight is an equal opportunities employer committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive, diverse and professional workplace for all. We strive to create a welcoming environment where all individuals, no matter their background or identity, feel valued and supported.

If you have specific requirements throughout the recruitment process, please reach out to a member of our HR team who will make the appropriate adjustments.

Apply today and join a dynamic, international team driving innovation across borders!

raw.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

WORK SCHEDULE

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS
Performs daily activities related to auditing, education and training of one or more content areas ERHI has coding oversight for
Serve as an expert in Inpatient coding , respond to general coding questions (ICD, DRG, CPT and HCPCS), engage in the development and/or implementation of audit/monitoring plans, participate in the development and/or delivery of educational and outreach materials, report on unit activities, maintain unit records, monitor regulatory developments, and help develop Coding program policies and procedure

DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION
Enterprise Records and Health Information (ERHI) is a Shared Service Department that supports all aspects of the patient medical record from governance, integrity, documentation timeliness, completion, clinical coding, billing, release, and tracking to management of access, retention, and destruction.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as an organization resource and content expert for current documentation and coding guidelines
  • Perform coding audits, analyze results and create audit reports and provide education and training on the results of internal audits and partner with Compliance on external audit education
  • Review DRG and CPT claim denials for commercial payers and maintain written documentation of actions, activities or assessments (e.g., investigations, patient rights, audits, process improvement projects, corrective action plans, education and training plans) in accordance with state and federal law, and institutional policies
  • Retains records in accordance with the UW Medicine Records Retention Schedule and department policy
  • Evaluate billing/coding/documentation behavior and identify recommendations for improvement
  • Review, analyze and determine effectiveness of training, assess effectiveness against entity/workforce member type/and industry KPI's and recommend enhancements to training content and user experience
  • Maintain written documentation of actions, activities or assessments (e.g., investigations, audits) in accordance with state and federal law, and institutional policies
  • Develop and deliver role-specific training for ERHI Coding staff, develop and implement effective monitoring, auditing and risk assessment activities
  • Manage or conduct audits, and ensure they are performed in accordance with the UW Medicine Audit Policy

REQUIRED POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in a Health Sciences discipline, Business Administration or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and/or work experience
  • Minimum of 3 years increasingly responsible related experience, including coding auditing, analysis, education and training.

  • Extensive knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding principles.
  • Strong communication, organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
  • Experience working in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and handle high-volume, detail-oriented work.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to establish positive working relationships across all levels of management and medical staff. Confidentiality and discretion in handling sensitive information.
  • Proficient in MS Office Suite.

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Care Coach evaluates member needs, coordinates care, and drives interventions that support improved health outcomes, member experience, and quality performance. You will collaborate closely with members, caregivers, providers, community organizations, and internal partners to identify and resolve barriers to care, close care gaps, and promote adherence to treatment plans across Humana's Medicare Advantage populations.

Schedule and Training

  • Work Style: Work at Home
  • Training: Mandatory for the first four weeks, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. ET.
  • Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 10:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m. ET after training.
  • Time off is not permitted during the first month of training. The first 90 days following training are critical to building a strong foundation; therefore, planned or unplanned time away should be minimized.

What Success Looks Like

  • You will engage members in Stars and quality initiatives, including Depression Screening and Follow-Up (DSF) and Follow-Up After Emergency Department Visit for People with Multiple High-Risk Chronic Conditions (FMC), and other evolving member outreach that improve member outcomes, experience, and organizational performance.
  • You will demonstrate agility and adaptability by supporting multiple Stars programs, including DSF, FMC, and other quality improvement initiatives as member health needs evolve.
  • You will conduct proactive telephonic outreach to members, primarily through an autodialer and other approved communication channels.
  • You will review available data and complete structured assessments to identify clinical, financial, functional, and social needs.
  • You will educate members about preventive care and connect them with appropriate healthcare, community, and social support resources.
  • You will collaborate with care managers, providers, and multidisciplinary partners to resolve barriers, promote member independence, and support desired health outcomes.
  • You will document assessments, outreach, and outcomes accurately and timely in applicable systems.
  • You will follow all program, regulatory, compliance, and documentation requirements.
  • You will navigate multiple computer systems while providing member-focused support in a fast-paced, structured environment.
  • You will adapt communication and workflow priorities to support diverse populations, evolving campaigns, and changing business needs.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree in any field.
  • At least two (2) years of direct adult patient care experience, such as long-term care, home- and community-based services, a hospital or facility setting, case management, or a managed care organization.
  • Experience collaborating with members of a healthcare team.
  • Strong computer proficiency and demonstrated ability to learn and navigate multiple software applications, including electronic medical records.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a telephonic environment working with geriatric, vulnerable, and/or low-income populations.
  • Experience supporting Medicare, Medicaid, Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans (D-SNP), Chronic Special Needs Plans (C-SNP), or other managed care populations.
  • Experience supporting quality improvement or Stars-related initiatives.
  • Experience conducting member outreach and engagement activities, up to and including screening for depression symptoms and other barriers of care.
  • Knowledge of community resources and social determinants of health.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.
  • Experience motivating others to improve their health.

Additional Information

  • Applicants who currently hold an RN, LPN, LVN, APRN, NP, LMSW, or LCSW license are not eligible for consideration for this position.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with members, providers, internal teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and healthcare documentation systems.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Interview Format


As part of our hiring process for this opportunity, we will be using an interviewing technology called Hirevue to enhance our hiring and decision-making ability. Hirevue allows us to quickly connect and gain valuable information from you pertaining to your relevant skills and experience at a time that is best for your schedule.


Text/Video Prescreen: Shortly after submitting your application, you may receive both a text message and email requesting you to complete prescreen questions with either yes or no answers. The text message may arrive prior to the email. If you prefer to answer via computer or tablet, wait for the email.

Interviews: Some candidates will be invited to interview. If so, the recruiter will send an invitation through Hirevue to schedule a day and time.

Offers: Finalists from the interview will be contacted by a recruiter to discuss the offer and benefits for the job


Note: Depending on the number of openings, the number of candidates who apply, and the schedules of interviewers and recruiters, this process may take several weeks or less; however, know that we are working hard to proceed as quickly as possible and to keep you informed.


Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.Florida Background Screening Requirements: Notice for candidates applying to this position from a Florida work location, including Florida home-based work location. This position is subject to Florida Level 2 background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse. For information about the screening process and requirements, visit:

Scheduled Weekly Hours

Pay Range

compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$53,700 - $72,600 per year

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

About Glooko

Glooko is a global digital health company on a mission to simplify diabetes and glycemic management across the care continuum. Our work connects people with diabetes, healthcare providers and diabetes devices through technology that makes diabetes care easier, more connected and more actionable.

At Glooko, we bring together people who are passionate about improving healthcare through innovation, collaboration and purpose-driven work. Our teams are building solutions that help clinicians streamline workflows, centralize diabetes data, support more informed decisions and improve care across outpatient and inpatient settings. At Glooko, employees have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful work that supports patients, providers and care teams around the world.

Glooko provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, or disability. In addition to federal law requirements, Glooko complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

About the Role

As a Technical Services Engineer, you will play a key role within our Business Operations team by powering the technology that connects healthcare providers and patients. This position combines technical support, deployment process improvements, and technical design expertise for both internal teams and external partners.

The Technical Services Engineer focuses on optimizing our healthcare technology solutions through strong technical knowledge and hands-on problem solving. Federal Business Development Apprenticeship
Location: Remote
This apprenticeship is open to all interested individuals. *Veterans can use their educational benefits for government business development training.OST’s Government Business Development Apprenticeship program is a comprehensiveone-year training program in the entire federal Government business development lifecycle, including opportunity identification and qualification, pipeline management, capture, and proposal development.

The apprenticeship combines 160 hours of job-related instruction to obtain national skills standards and on-the-job training provided by the apprentice employer. Participants must pass skills tests at each segment of the program.

Employers use this Government-certified program to prepare their future workforce with essential BD skills for Government contracting.The program consists of 12 parts that include various courses.

Ideal candidate description:

A strong candidate for OST Global Solutions, Inc. (OST) Business Development (BD) Apprenticeship Program is a motivated, high-potential professional seeking to either launch or strategically advance their career in BD. This individual is committed to mastering the full BD lifecycle and leveraging the program to drive measurable growth outcomes—personally, professionally, and organizationally. They will also demonstrate dedication to a rigorous, multi-month program, showing resilience, curiosity, coachability, and the drive to apply what they learn in real-world settings to produce outcomes.

The ideal candidate may fall into one or more of the following categories:

  • Career Changers: Professionals from adjacent disciplines (e.g., operations, marketing, technical roles) looking to transition into BD with a structured, high-impact learning experience.
  • Early-Career BD Professionals: Individuals with limited but hands-on BD exposure who want to elevate their skills, confidence, and performance to become standout contributors on a BD team.
  • Team Enhancers: Participants from companies with developing or informal BD structures, looking to introduce rigor, strategy, and repeatability into their team’s BD processes.
  • Future Executives: Ambitious individuals with long-term goals of becoming a senior BD leader (e.g., Chief Growth Officer, VP of BD, Director of BD), and who seek foundational and strategic BD acumen to lead growth organizations effectively.
  • Entrepreneurial Builders: Aspiring founders or current small business owners who want to build and scale a private sector company through the advanced BD practices acquired through OST’s program.
  • Internal Champions: Employees within existing companies aiming to create or lead a new BD Group and implement best practices to professionalize BD within the organization.
What you will learn in the first two months:
  • The initial Stages of Business Development
  • A Deep Dive Into the Capture Process
  • How to Write & Manage Winning Proposals
  • How to Grow Your Business Development Department
What you will learn in the remaining 10 months - Overview(a combination of classroom, workshops, and OJL supplements):
  • Foundations of Federal Business Development
  • Foundations of Capture Management
  • Proposal Theme Statements and Win Strategy
  • Foundations of Proposal Management
  • How to Develop a Compliant Proposal
  • Writing Persuasive Government Proposals
  • Winning Government Cost Proposals
  • Proposal Editing Workshop
  • Proposal Graphics COnceptualization and Design
  • Desktop Publishing for Proposal Professionals

  • Chapter 30: Montgomery GI Bill
  • Chapter 33: Post 9/11 GI Bill
  • Chapter 35: Survivors’ and Dependents’ Educational Assistance
  • Chapter 1606: Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserve Program

Als Mitarbeiter Kundenservice & Software Support (m/w/d) unterstützt Du Pflegeeinrichtungen dabei, unsere Softwarelösungen erfolgreich einzusetzen und Herausforderungen im Arbeitsalltag schnell zu lösen. Mit Deiner Arbeit sorgst Du dafür, dass Pflegekräfte und soziale Einrichtungen sich auf funktionierende Software verlassen können und mehr Zeit für die Menschen haben, die sie betreuen.

Was du bewirkst

  • Unterstütze unsere Kunden telefonisch bei Fragen zu den Softwarelösungen MD Ambulant und MD Stationär
  • Analysiere Kundenanliegen und entwickle passende sowie nachvollziehbare Lösungswege
  • Berate Anwender bei technischen und anwendungsbezogenen Fragestellungen
  • Dokumentiere Anfragen, Lösungswege und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar in unserem Ticketsystem
  • Arbeite eng mit dem 2nd Level Support und weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen, um komplexere Anliegen erfolgreich zu lösen
  • Begleite unsere Kunden bei der sicheren und erfolgreichen Nutzung ihrer Software
  • Sorge für eine verlässliche und serviceorientierte Betreuung im täglichen Kundenkontakt

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im kaufmännischen, technischen, IT oder gesundheitsnahen Umfeld
  • Erfahrung im telefonischen Kundenservice sowie Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Kunden
  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Ticketsystemen und der nachvollziehbaren Dokumentation von Kundenanliegen
  • Freundliche, empathische und serviceorientierte Kommunikation
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (06:00 bis 20:00 Uhr) von Montag bis Freitag
  • Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Rufbereitschaften nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung
  • Interesse daran, Dich in neue Softwareprodukte, technische Themen und Prozesse einzuarbeiten

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit Salesforce Service Cloud oder vergleichbaren Tools
  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Fernwartungslösungen wie TeamViewer
  • Berührungspunkte mit dem Gesundheitswesen, der Pflege oder dem Sozialwesen

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Serviceorientierung Du stellst die Anliegen unserer Kunden in den Mittelpunkt und schaffst durch verlässliche Unterstützung Vertrauen
  • Teamgeist Du arbeitest konstruktiv mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv
  • Lösungsorientierung Du behältst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen den Überblick und entwickelst pragmatische Lösungswege
  • Lernbereitschaft Du gehst offen auf neue Themen zu und entwickelst Dein Wissen kontinuierlich weiter

Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Du entscheidest: Hansefit, EGYM Wellpass, Kinderbetreuung oder JobRad – wir unterstützen Dich flexibel mit einem Zuschuss von bis zu 60 € monatlich. Zusätzlich profitierst Du von exklusiven Vergünstigungen mit Corporate Benefits
  • Du kannst auf uns zählen – TELUS Health stärkt Dich mit individuellen Angeboten für Deine mentale Gesundheit
  • Wir gestalten Deine Entwicklung – mit LinkedIn Learning hast Du Zugriff auf inspirierende Lerninhalte und praxisnahe Weiterbildung, die Dich wirklich voranbringen
  • Wir denken an Deine Zukunft – mit unserem Aktienkaufprogramm kannst Du direkt am Unternehmenserfolg teilhaben, und durch unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) sicherst Du Dir finanzielle Stabilität für die Zukunft
  • Du hast 30 Tage Urlaubsanspruch, um ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen zu haben

MEDIFOX DAN Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Hildesheim gehört zur Resmed Corp. und beschäftigt über 900 Mitarbeitende an neun Standorten. Wir setzen auf Teamgeist, Kundenorientierung und Leidenschaft und arbeiten an zukunftsweisenden Softwarelösungen im Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen, um Innovationen voranzutreiben. Seit über 30 Jahren revolutionieren wir die Pflegebranche und suchen Menschen, die eine Leidenschaft für Technik in einer starken Unternehmenskultur teilen.

raw.description:
BANC OF CALIFORNIA AND YOUR CAREER

Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC) is a bank holding company with over $34 billion in assets and the parent company of Banc of California. Banc of California is one of the nation’s premier relationship-based business banks, providing banking and treasury management services to small, middle market, and venture backed businesses. As the largest independent bank headquartered in California, the bank offers a broad range of loan and deposit products and services through a network of full-service branches and regional offices, as well as through digital and nationwide capabilities. The bank also provides full-service payment processing solutions to its clients and serves the Community Association Management industry nationwide through its technology forward platform, SmartStreet™. Banc of California is committed to supporting its local communities through the Banc of California Charitable Foundation and by partnering with organizations that promote financial literacy, job training, small business support, affordable housing, and more.

At Banc of California, our success is powered by our people and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful results. We foster an environment where entrepreneurial thinking is encouraged, and accountability and operational excellence are expected. Our team members are empowered to take ownership, make informed decisions, and make a meaningful impact as the bank continues to grow and evolve. We are dedicated to supporting your growth and wellbeing through comprehensive benefits, robust development opportunities, and inclusive programs that enable you to perform at your best. Together we win!

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Business Development Officer (“BDO”) is responsible for originating and funding SBA 7(a) and SBA 504 loans through self-sourced business development efforts. Qualified candidates will bring a strong track record in commercial real estate and cash flow lending, with demonstrated success consistently originating and funding $10 million to $15 million or more annually.

The BDO is accountable for driving new SBA lending opportunities through the development of strong referral and client relationships and partners cross functionally to deliver well structured transactions that meet borrower needs, align with credit standards, and comply with all applicable regulatory requirements. Performs all duties in accordance with the Company’s policies and procedures, all U.S. state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the Company operates.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE

  • Establishing new referral and client relationships and fostering existing relationships
  • Independently source new loan transactions; this position does not receive internal branch referrals.
  • Assisting in the initial pre-screening, qualifying and structuring of loan opportunities
  • Analyze business and personal federal tax returns, including balance sheets and profit and loss statements.
  • Maintain regular communication with clients and referral partners regarding transaction status.
  • Partner with Underwriting and Closing to determine appropriate transaction structure and lending parameters.
  • Follow all established policies and procedures.
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Required:
    • Minimum 7 years of experience in a commercial lending environment
    • Bachelor’s Degree or additional equivalent experience
  • Preferred:
    • Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting
  • Strong analytical, technical and documentation skills, strong time management and organizational skills
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships; capable of working independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Established local and/or national market presence with a strong sphere of influence.
  • Experienced and knowledgeable in originating SBA 7a and SBA 504 loan products
  • Familiarity with Small Business Administration Standard Operating Procedures and eligibility requirements
  • Established referral network, including business and real estate brokers, accountants, attorneys, and other commercial banking relationships and community groups.
  • Possesses strong credit skills to determine the appropriate loan structure and assess credit risk of applicants.
  • Familiarity with technology used in the loan origination process, including standard office software (Microsoft word, excel, etc.), with the ability to quickly adapt to new platforms and tools.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of, adherence to, monitoring and responsibility for compliance with state and federal regulations and laws as they pertain to this position including but not limited to the following: Regulation Z (Truth in Lending Act), Regulation B (Equal Credit Opportunity Act), Fair Housing Act (FHA), Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA), Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) in conjunction with the USA PATRIOT Act, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Customer Information Program (CIP), Right to Financial Privacy Act (RFPA, state and federal) and Community Reinvestment Act (CRA)
  • High School diploma or equivalent required

HOW WE’LL SUPPORT YOU

  • Financial Security:You will be eligible to participate in the company’s 401k plan which includes a company match and immediate vesting.
  • Health & Well-Being:We offer comprehensive insurance options including medical, dental, vision, AD&D, supplemental life, long-term disability, pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, and pre-tax Flexible Spending Account (FSA).
  • Building & Supporting Your Family: Banc of California partners with providers that offer adoption, surrogacy, and fertility assistance as well as paid parental leave and family support solutions including care options for your family.
  • Paid Time Away: Eligible team members receive paid vacation days, holidays, and volunteer time off.
  • Career Growth Opportunities: To support career growth of our team members, we offer tuition reimbursement, an annual mentorship program, leadership development resources, access to LinkedIn Learning, and more.

SALARY RANGE

The base salary ultimately offered is determined through a review of education, industry experience, training, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant in alignment with market data and other factors.

Banc of California is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their actual or perceived race (including traits associated with race, such as hair texture, hair type or protective hairstyles), religion or religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), color, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, gender transitioning, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, military or veteran status, medical condition, genetic information, or disability (mental or physical), requests for accommodation and any additional protected categories set forth in applicable federal, state or local laws. If you require reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, please contact Talent Acquisition.

raw.title: Sr Business Analyst (Pharmacovigilance & AI Systems)
raw.excerpt: ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESRequirements Engineering• Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
raw.description:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Requirements Engineering

  • Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
  • Produce the supporting artefacts: as-is and to-be process maps, data-flow diagrams, user stories with acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, interface specifications and non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security, auditability, data retention).
  • Build and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix from URS to FRS to design, test cases and validation evidence, so every requirement can be implemented and tested.
  • Run requirement reviews with PV operations, Quality, IT Security, Data Privacy and Engineering; manage change control on approved requirements.
  • Prioritize with the Product Owner, write release-level scope statements and support sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Domain coverage

You will specify requirements across the following modules, working with the respective PV subject-matter experts:

  • Global and local literature search strategy management, database connectors (MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase and others), de-duplication, AI-assisted relevance screening and ICSR identification, full-text handling, reviewer workflow, hit-level audit trail, reconciliation and KPIs; alignment with GVP Module VI and local literature requirements.
  • Multi-channel intake (email, portal, call centre, partner feeds, literature, social media), duplicate detection, AI-assisted data extraction from unstructured sources, MedDRA and WHODrug coding support, seriousness and expectedness assessment, narrative generation with human review, E2B(R3) submission, follow-up management, and integration with safety databases (e.g. Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety).
  • Data sources (safety database, EudraVigilance, FAERS, literature), disproportionality and signal detection methods, signal validation, prioritisation, assessment and tracking workflows, signal-to-risk linkage, and documentation aligned to GVP Module IX.
  • Data retrieval and reconciliation, line listings and summary tabulations, AI-assisted section drafting with locked source-to-text traceability, author and reviewer workflow, version control, schedule and submission tracking, aligned to 21 CFR 314.80 and ICH E2C(R2).
  • Source and channel configuration, listening rules, AI classification of posts for potential adverse events, identifiability and validity criteria, PII handling, reviewer workflow and conversion to case intake, aligned to GVP Module VI and FDA guidance on internet and social media.
  • PSMF support, audit-trail reporting and query, compliance dashboards (timeliness, quality, backlog), deviation and CAPA linkage, document and training evidence retrieval, and the ability to reproduce any AI-assisted decision on request.

Agentic AI specifics

  • Define, for every agent in the platform, its role, inputs, tools, permitted actions and decision authority, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a qualified person must review, approve or override.
  • Specify AI output acceptance criteria with the SMEs: target precision and recall for screening and classification tasks, confidence thresholds for auto-routing versus human review, and how performance is measured and monitored in production.
  • Write requirements for explainability and auditability of AI decisions: rationale capture, source citation, prompt and model version logging, reproducibility, and retention of the evidence an inspector would ask for.
  • Specify guardrails: what agents must never do without human approval (e.g. submit an ICSR, close a signal, finalise a report), handling of low-confidence or out-of-distribution inputs, and fallback behaviour when a model or tool is unavailable.
  • Define requirements for model lifecycle governance: evaluation datasets, change control for prompts and models, regression testing, periodic review, and restrictions on use of client data for model training.

Regulatory, quality and privacy compliance

  • Translate the following into explicit, testable requirements and work with Quality on validation strategy:
    • 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11: electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access control, data integrity (ALCOA+), system security, record retention and retrieval.
    • GDPR and other applicable data-protection laws: lawful basis, data minimisation, pseudonymisation, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, retention and deletion, privacy by design; support Data Protection Impact Assessments.
    • GVP Modules (notably I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX) and ICH E2B(R3), E2C(R2), E2D, E2E as they apply to each module.
    • Computerised system validation: GAMP 5 (second edition), risk-based and Computer Software Assurance approaches; author or contribute to validation plans, functional risk assessments, test strategies and traceability.
    • Quality Management System requirements for product development: SDLC procedures, change control, deviation and CAPA management, supplier qualification, documentation standards; alignment with ISO 9001 and information-security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
    • Emerging AI-specific regulation and guidance (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA positions on AI in pharmacovigilance and GxP): assess applicability, track developments and reflect them in requirements.
  • Act as the requirements-side point of contact during internal audits and client or regulatory inspections of the platform.

Stakeholder and delivery

  • Work day-to-day with PV operations leads, medical reviewers, Quality Assurance, Data Privacy, IT Security, product management, UX, data scientists and engineers.
  • Support UAT: author or review test scripts against the FRS, coordinate business testers, triage defects and confirm requirement coverage.
  • Prepare release notes, user-facing functional documentation and training inputs for operations teams.
  • Contribute to client-facing material describing how the platform meets regulatory expectations.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, computer science or a related field.
  • 6+ years in pharmacovigilance or PV systems, with at least 3 years in a business analyst, systems analyst or product requirements role on GxP software.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring URS and FRS (and ideally validation documentation) for PV or other regulated life-sciences systems.
  • Working knowledge of at least four of the six domain areas above, gained in operations, a safety-system implementation or a technology vendor; hands-on familiarity with at least one commercial safety database (Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety or equivalent).
  • Solid understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, data-integrity principles and GDPR, and of how they translate into system requirements.
  • Experience working within a QMS and formal SDLC (change control, CSV/CSA, traceability, deviation handling).
  • Practical understanding of how LLMs and AI agents work, their failure modes, and what it takes to make their output acceptable in a regulated setting. Prior involvement in an AI or automation project in PV is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical writing: you can produce a requirement that an engineer can build, a tester can test and an auditor can verify, without ambiguity.
  • Comfortable with Agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.

Preferred

  • Experience with E2B(R3) implementation, MedDRA and WHODrug coding, and EudraVigilance or FAERS data.
  • Experience specifying NLP, machine-learning or GenAI features (classification, extraction, summarisation) including evaluation metrics and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with GAMP 5 second edition and the FDA Computer Software Assurance approach.
  • Awareness of the EU AI Act and of EMA/FDA reflection papers on AI in the medicinal-product lifecycle.
  • Prior participation in regulatory inspections or client audits of PV systems.
  • Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or ISPE/GAMP training.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

raw.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role

We are looking for a Specialist Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This role can be based in any major city in the western or central regions, reporting to the Director - Zero Trust Branch. You will support the commercial segment, acting as the primary specialist to drive revenue growth within the Zero Trust Branch product suite, including Zero Trust SDWAN, IoT/OT device segmentation and Zero Trust Cellular. You will lead the charge in demonstrating the power of cloud transformation to cement our position as a global leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Serve as the primary specialist for customers, partners, and internal teams to drive revenue growth across the zero trust branch (ZTB) product portfolio
  • Partner with domain-expert solution engineers to capture customer requirements and craft compelling value propositions that close complex business deals
  • Own the regional quota and territory achievement by building and implementing account-based strategies to land and expand ZTB solutions
  • Collaborate synergistically with primary sales teams and leadership to ensure a unified and effective Zscaler presence in the market
  • Engage stakeholders across the organization, selling effectively to both C-suite executives and technical practitioners

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 3+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Progressive experience engaging with and selling to accounts at the C-level
  • Demonstrated expertise and practical experience with value-based selling methodologies

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Established relationships with current and prospective customers within the enterprise security landscape
  • Direct experience selling SDWAN and advanced networking solutions
  • Proven proficiency in strategic sales planning and a track record of closing net new logos
  • Effectively leverage LLMs and Generative AI tools to boost productivity and sales effectiveness across research, prospecting, customer prep, and opportunity management

· 5+ years selling to regional or mid-market health plans, with a record of closing multi-stakeholder deals

· Proven hunter: opened new plan accounts, or new lines of business inside existing plans, and exceeded quota

· Track record managing a larger number of concurrent accounts and shorter sales cycles than a national accounts role, with accurate forecasting

· Working knowledge of Risk Adjustment, Quality (HEDIS, Star Ratings), and Medicare Advantage; familiarity with Medicaid and ACA Marketplace quality and risk programs

· Strong analytical and presentation skills; able to build a business case for a payer executive

· Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

· Strong written and verbal communication skills

· Ability to travel 50-75%

Competencies:

· Hunter drive: persistent, resilient, and results-focused; consistently exceeds quota

· Pipeline velocity: prioritizes a broad account list by fit and likelihood to close, and keeps stage discipline tight

· Account strategy: plans land-and-expand pursuits across lines of business and adjusts as they develop

Benefits

WORKING AT VATICA HEALTH ADVANTAGES

Good Health

Happiness

As a Senior Account Executive, you will play a key role in helping customers achieve better business outcomes with Dropbox’s full suite of products.

You’ll build trusted relationships with both existing and prospective customers, develop a deep understanding of their priorities, and connect them with Dropbox solutions that improve how their teams organize, collaborate, share, and secure their work.

This role combines strategic account management with strong sales execution. You’ll partner closely with customers and internal teams to develop account strategies, demonstrate the value of Dropbox’s integrated product portfolio, and deliver solutions that support customers’ evolving needs.

This is an opportunity to help customers get more value from Dropbox while directly contributing to the company’s growth and long-term customer relationships.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through close and renewal within your territory
  • Build pipeline from scratch by prospecting into new teams, departments, and executive stakeholders
  • Expand beyond existing motions to uncover new use cases and opportunities
  • Consistently generate pipeline through outbound efforts, account mapping, events, and partner collaboration
  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline to consistently meet or exceed revenue targets
  • Lead strong discovery to uncover customer challenges, priorities, and desired outcomes
  • Apply structured qualification and value-selling frameworks(e.g., MEDDICC, SPICED) to advance deals

Requirements

  • 6+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally including time in early-stage, new product, or evolving GTM environments
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline and close deals in ambiguous or evolving markets
  • Strong experience with qualification frameworks such as MEDDICC, SPICED, or similar
  • Demonstrated use of value selling methodologies such as Command of the Message or equivalent
  • Experience selling to mid-market and enterprise customers, including executive stakeholders
  • Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • High ownership mentality - you take initiative and move things forward without waiting for direction
  • Thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook
  • Curious and business-oriented, with the ability to connect customer problems to solutions
  • Resourceful and adaptable - you figure things out and adjust quickly
  • Strong collaborator who contributes positively to team culture

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling a new or emerging product within an existing portfolio
  • Experience working in high-change or transformation environments

Durable Skills

  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Job Description:

PRINCIPAL AI AUTONOMY SYSTEMS INTEGRATOR (UAS / SWARMING / C2 / EDGE AI)

Hands‑On Engineering • Autonomous System Integration • Mission‑Thread Enablement

Itegrate autonomy software with real assets, validate behaviors in simulation and field environments, and ensure that autonomous agents act over trusted data, in real time, under real mission pressures.


MISSION & IMPACT

Autonomy Integration & System Engineering

  • Integrate autonomy stacks onto UAS, multi‑vehicle swarms, and robotic platforms, including navigation, perception, cooperative behaviors, and distributed decision-making.
  • Implement real‑time autonomy pipelines that incorporate sensing, fusion, planning, and control across diverse air/ground systems.
  • Adapt and optimize autonomy algorithms for constrained edge environments (embedded systems, GPUs/VPUs, tactical compute nodes).

Data‑ and Knowledge‑Aligned Autonomy

  • Build data pipelines and semantic alignment layers so autonomous systems operate against trusted, structured, and meaning‑preserving data representations.
  • Integrate autonomy with ontology-driven or schema-governed data models to ensure consistent entity tracking, mission-state representation, and decision context.
  • Enable retrieval‑grounded behaviors where autonomous agents act based on authoritative, updated, and fused situational information.

Edge Deployment Across Contested Environments

  • Deploy AI/ML models and autonomy services to edge compute environments (K3s/RKE2, containers, bare metal).
  • Harden autonomy behaviors for degraded communications, GPS denial, EW threats, sensor loss, and variable latency.
  • Implement resilient synchronization patterns between edge devices and enterprise/tactical nodes.

Simulation, Experimentation, and Field Testing

  • Conduct structured field experiments with unmanned vehicles, swarms, multi‑agent behaviors, and C2 workflows.
  • Validate mission‑thread performance across detection, tasking, coordination, and operator-in-the-loop behaviors.

Agentic Workflow Integration

  • Integrate agent frameworks enabling autonomy agents to plan, coordinate, task, and interact with mission tools and human operators.
  • Define safety gates, oversight mechanisms, and deterministic tool‑use patterns that support “human‑on‑the‑loop” operations.
  • Support multi‑agent cooperation through standard APIs and interoperable messaging patterns.

C2, Networks, and Cross‑Domain Integration

  • Integrate autonomous systems with tactical C2 platforms, data links, secure communications, and multi‑domain operational workflows.
  • Implement open standards (MOSA, SOSA, CMOSS, open messaging protocols) for plug‑and‑play component integration.
  • Enable interoperability across joint, partner‑nation, and coalition environments with appropriate policy controls.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build full autonomy pipelines end‑to‑end, from sensing through action execution.
  • Deploy CV, tracking, SLAM, pattern‑learning, anomaly detection, and cooperative‑agent models on real unmanned systems.
  • Integrate heterogeneous sensors, radios, and payloads with autonomy decision loops.
  • Conduct troubleshooting and rapid problem resolution across autonomy software, embedded systems, edge clusters, and C2 interfaces.
  • Translate mission problems into executable autonomy behaviors and scenario‑specific workflows.
  • Train teams and mission personnel on system configuration, safety, deployment, and best practices.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Core Background

  • Education: BA/BS or equivalent
  • Experience: 10+ years in unmanned systems, autonomy engineering, robotics integration, or embedded AI/ML deployment.
  • Direct experience integrating autonomy into UAS, drones, swarms, robotic vehicles, or similar platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in C++, Python, and real‑time/embedded software patterns.

Technical Expertise

  • Autonomy functions: motion planning, cooperative behaviors, obstacle avoidance, distributed coordination, sensor fusion, and real‑time decision-making.
  • Robotics frameworks: ROS/ROS2, PX4/ArduPilot, MAVLink, simulation tools (Gazebo, AirSim, custom environments).
  • AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, JAX.
  • Edge compute: NVIDIA Jetson, VPUs, ruggedized x86 nodes, tactical accelerators.
  • Containerization and DevSecOps: Docker, Kubernetes (K3s/RKE2), GitLab CI, ArgoCD.
  • Interoperability standards: open architectures, modular interfaces, secure API design.

Domain Understanding

  • Experience supporting C2 integration, tactical networks, and degraded-communication workflows.
  • Understanding of multi‑domain mission threads such as ISR, counter‑UAS, logistics autonomy, multi-agent coordination, and decision-support.
  • Experience designing resilient behavior under environmental, adversarial, and operational stressors.

Security Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Top Secret/SCI Required to start

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with distributed track fusion, detection/classification pipelines, or multi-sensor correlation.
  • Familiarity with mission‑partner interoperability and cross‑domain data release patterns.
  • Experience implementing provenance, auditability, and safety‑bounded autonomy behaviors.
  • Background in private 5G, tactical mesh networking, or mobile operations centers.

WHY THIS ROLE IS UNIQUE

This Principal-level role is tailored for someone who:

  • Builds autonomy that works in real field conditions, not just in demos.
  • Bridges AI models, mission data, and real unmanned systems.
  • Ensures autonomous behaviors are grounded in trusted, structured information.
  • Understands both the engineering and the operational realities of deploying autonomy at scale.
  • Can integrate across sensors, payloads, compute, C2, and enterprise systems.

You are the person who makes autonomous systems reliable, interoperable, safe, and mission-ready.


GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.
● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your sense of ownership and pride in the meaningful work we do.

Job Description:

The Sr. Human Resources Business Partner - Technology provides senior leadership for complex Talent Management engagements, programs, or operational priorities, directing delivery, managing risk, and advancing consistent quality across teams and stakeholders. The role contributes directly to the effectiveness of the team and the quality of the services or support provided to stakeholders.

The role is expected to apply relevant technical knowledge, established methodologies, and professional judgment; understand stakeholder needs and maintain responsive, trusted working relationships; and set clear expectations, coordinate work, and support the growth and performance of team members. The position identifies issues, communicates practical recommendations, and maintains complete and accurate documentation appropriate to the work.

The position collaborates across the firm and with relevant stakeholders to advance client service and relationship outcomes, strategic and operational priorities, account growth and business-development efforts and team capability and talent development. Success is demonstrated through effective communication, strong organization, thoughtful problem-solving, and consistent follow-through.


Responsibilities:


  • As a Strategic Business Partner / Senior Manager, Talent Management on our People Solutions (Human Resources) team, you will feel a great sense of pride and accomplishment through measurable contributions within your team, our firm and most importantly – our people.
  • This is an opportunity to be a strategic, valued asset by offering your expertise in talent management to continue to propel our firm forward.
  • Passionate about building and leveraging strategic relationships to influence business success.
  • Committed to driving a culture of diversity and inclusion where exceptional people thrive.
  • Seek continuous improvement and yearn to belong within a firm which provides autonomy and support – guiding you forward with endless opportunities now, for tomorrow.
  • A strategic thinker with the ability to use a consultative approach to manage your internal clients’ needs and move forward firm objectives and initiatives.
  • Be a key leader within the talent management team helping provide a best in class experience for our people.
  • Collaborate with leadership to create and recommend employee engagement and retention strategies.
  • Develop and analyze people related metrics to understand trends and translate into business solutions.
  • Create a cohesive approach across all People Solutions areas promoting the acquisition, development, and success of talent that enhances organizational health and drives a high performance culture.
  • Lead key initiatives which support the firm’s vision, growth, and people strategies.
  • Provide guidance and leadership in employee relations, interpreting complex employment laws and policies and making recommendations for improvement.
  • Facilitate and support the performance management and compensation review process; serving as a coach and advisor to managers and leaders.
  • Conduct internal investigations related to employee issues and bring them to resolution.
  • Ensure the organization's compliance with local, state and federal regulations.
  • Ability to deploy firm-wide People Solutions initiatives to the market, field questions and ensure consistency, understanding and adoption.
  • Embrace and drive diversity and inclusion initiatives.
  • Provide leadership, guidance and mentorship to the talent management team to ensure a high level of service to our internal clients.
  • Support the growth and development of team members through Baker Tilly’s learning philosophy, helping associates meet their professional goals.
  • Drive business development through executive client relationship expansion, proposals, executive presentations, strategic pursuits, and account growth while identifying opportunities to expand practice capabilities and broader Baker Tilly services.
  • Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration or other related field required, master’s degree preferred
  • HR certification (e.g., SHRM‑CP, PHR) preferred.
  • Eight years of relevant experience in talent management or a related field
  • Working knowledge of the principles, processes, methodologies, and quality standards relevant to Talent Management.
  • Ability to analyze information, identify issues, document conclusions, and communicate practical recommendations appropriate to the role level.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the systems, applications, research tools, and collaboration platforms used by the team.
  • Ability to manage priorities, maintain accurate and complete documentation, protect confidential information, and meet established deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, collaboration, problem-solving, organization, and professional judgment.

raw.excerpt: Our Story: Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc.  (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services.
raw.description:
Our Story:
Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc. (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services. Our programs teach professionals the skills to recognize, prevent, and respond to crises in the workplace. Since 1980, we’ve helped train more than 17 million people across service‑oriented industries including education, health care, behavioral health, long‑term care, human services, security, corporate, and retail.
At CPI, we are dedicated to changing behaviors and reducing conflict for the Care, Welfare, Safety, and Security of everyone. We believe empathy, meaningful connections, personal safety, and security are the antidotes to fear and anxiety. This philosophy is central to everything we do and traces back to our beginning.
As a member of the team, you can expect to:
  • Make a difference through your work — You’ll be proud to tell your family and friends what you do.
  • Gain significant career experience within a fast‑growing organization — From entry‑level roles to executive leadership.
  • Feel fulfilled and have fun — We work hard but make time to build meaningful relationships and celebrate wins.
The Role:
As we evolve our product portfolio and go-to-market approach, we're looking for a hands-on Director of Product Marketing to build CPI's Product Marketing capability and help translate customer, market, and product insight into clearer positioning, stronger commercialization, and better go-to-market decisions.
This is a builder-doer role. You'll help shape how Product Marketing works at CPI, but you'll also personally do much of the work: developing positioning and messaging, working through portfolio and packaging questions, building commercialization plans, translating customer research into recommendations, and creating the tools teams need to bring our offerings to market.
You'll work closely with Product and Marketing leadership and lead a team spanning Industry Marketing and Customer Insights. We're looking for someone who moves quickly, learns fast, asks good questions, and is excited to build alongside the team rather than inherit an established Product Marketing function.

What You Get to Do Every Day:

Build & Execute Product Marketing
  • Develop positioning, messaging, value propositions, buyer stories, and commercialization strategies for CPI's priority products and audiences.
  • Personally create early Product Marketing deliverables and frameworks while establishing repeatable approaches the broader team can use over time.
  • Partner with Product and revenue leadership to evaluate and develop recommendations across the commercial mix, including product and portfolio structure, pricing and packaging, routes to market and buying experience, and how offerings are positioned and promoted.
  • Execute priority pricing and packaging work, bringing together customer value, competitive context, market insight, business economics, and buying behavior to develop and pressure-test recommendations.
  • Translate product capabilities and roadmap investments into clear customer value, market opportunities, and go-to-market recommendations.
Turn Customer & Market Insight into Action
  • Direct the Senior Manager, Customer Insights to identify the customer, buyer, market, and competitive questions CPI needs to answer and ensure research informs commercial decisions.
  • Synthesize customer, market, competitive, and commercial information into useful recommendations for segmentation, positioning, product strategy, commercialization, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Lead CPI's industry marketing approach across healthcare and education, working with Industry Marketing Managers to translate market dynamics, buyer needs, industry trends, and product strategy into differentiated industry positioning and go-to-market priorities.
  • Develop the team's ability to become true industry experts, connecting ongoing market learning, customer insight, Sales feedback, and external trends to the work CPI brings to market.
  • Develop evidence-based understanding of priority segments, buyers, needs, use cases, buying dynamics, and competitive alternatives and translate it into practical tools for Product, Marketing, and Sales.
Bring Products & Offerings to Market
  • Develop and execute commercialization plans for priority launches, product changes, and market opportunities in close partnership with Product, Demand Generation, Sales, and other teams.
  • Build and put into practice a repeatable commercialization and launch process, including launch tiering and readiness criteria, that helps CPI determine the appropriate level of go-to-market support based on customer impact, commercial opportunity, and organizational readiness.
  • Create the positioning, messaging, buyer insights, competitive context, sales stories, and core enablement materials customer-facing teams need to effectively bring offerings to market.
  • Work with Industry Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, Program Management, and other teams to bring priority offerings to market and use results and feedback to improve future launches.
Build the Capability While Doing the Work
  • Lead and develop Industry Marketing and Customer Insights, working alongside the team to establish what strong Product Marketing and market-led decision-making look like.
  • Help clarify roles, processes, and ways of working across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success as CPI builds a more disciplined commercialization model.
  • Take on priority commercial problems alongside Product and Marketing leadership, quickly moving from ambiguity to analysis, recommendation, and execution.
  • Use AI, external expertise, and new ways of working to move quickly, increase the team's capabilities, and solve unfamiliar problems.
You Need to Have:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Product Management, or related field
  • 7+ years of experience across Product Marketing, Product Management, Customer/Market Insights, Go-to-Market Strategy, Commercialization, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience, including experience building teams, functions, or new organizational capabilities.
  • Demonstrated success building or transforming Product Marketing capabilities in an organization where product architecture, segmentation, positioning, commercialization, or go-to-market disciplines were evolving.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, segmentation, go-to-market plans, commercialization materials, and pricing or packaging recommendations for complex B2B products or service.
  • Comfortable getting into the work, learning what you don’t know, and developing recommendations rather than handing the problem to someone else.
  • Ability to quickly learn an unfamiliar market or product, synthesize customer, competitive, product, and business information, and turn it into clear recommendations or deliverables.
  • Experience building or significantly evolving Product Marketing capabilities and working alongside a team while creating greater structure, discipline, and clarity.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment where roles and processes are still evolving.
We’d Love to See:
  • Experience leading a team and launching and commercializing complex B2B products, services, or solutions.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Sales.
  • Experience working across pricing and packaging, portfolio strategy, customer or market research, sales enablement, or AI-enabled ways of working.
What We Offer:
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • 401k
  • PTO
  • Health & Wellness Days
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Continuing education and training
  • Hybrid / Remote work schedule
  • Paid Parental Leave

We created Holiday World to inspire, celebrate, and unite people through holidays, as well as all the traditions and rituals that accompany them. As the first inclusive destination devoted to sharing a global lens on holiday celebrations and preparation, Holiday World is a catalyst for more diverse storytelling and cross-cultural education.
