We’re hiring an Editor-in-Chief with extensive experience in journalism, a strong understanding of the publishing industry and its changing landscape.   • and influence over editorial, content creation and copywriting.

raw.title: Senior Product Designer
raw.excerpt: Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed.
raw.description:
Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed. Our tax preparation software offers easy guidance and ensures your maximum tax refund. We strive to build a team of like-minded experts in both tax and technology who align with our brand purpose, are advocates for our customers and have a fresh, non-traditional approach to the tax industry.

Position Summary


Taxwell is looking to hire a Senior Product Designer to join our mission of making it affordable and easy for individuals and businesses to digitally file their taxes. This individual will apply design principles and methodologies to elevate our experience, championing AI-native thinking across the product organization. They will collaborate closely with product management and development teams to build industry-leading experiences that achieve business objectives and elevate customer outcomes. For this role, we expect a level of AI fluency that shows clear evidence that AI is changing the role and improving outcomes.


What You’ll Do


Design Excellence & Craft

  • Create user experiences and interfaces for product prototypes in keeping with industry standards and best practices
  • Translate user needs and business requirements into compelling experiences across web, mobile, and AI-driven touchpoints
  • Create user journeys, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes across multiple devices and interfaces
  • Create low- and high-fidelity prototypes to communicate design intent, using AI-assisted tools to rapidly explore and iterate on concepts

AI-Powered Product Design

  • Design innovative features that leverage generative AI to transform how users interact with and complete their tax filing experience
  • Contribute to defining what AI-native experiences look and feel like at scale across the Taxwell product ecosystem
  • Develop reusable AI-informed design patterns and interaction paradigms that can be applied across products and surfaces

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with product management, engineering, research, and data science to define, iterate, and ship features, ensuring alignment across user needs, business goals, and technical constraints
  • Recommend metrics to define, manage, and measure design success and prioritize enhancements

Communication & Storytelling

  • Create and present strategies and recommendations to design partners and stakeholders, articulating rationale clearly and confidently
  • Use expertise, storytelling, and persuasion to influence the product vision and design
  • Measure and explain the value of design to stakeholders using qualitative and quantitative data

AI Fluency Expectations


At Taxwell, we assess AI fluency across four dimensions—Mindset, Strategy, Building, and Accountability.

  • Mindset: You don’t just use AI—you fundamentally rethink how design work gets done. You abandon the status quo when it no longer serves, and you lead others through that transformation. Your AI fluency trajectory shows continuous evolution and a willingness to reinvent your own practice
  • Strategy: Evaluate emerging AI capabilities (LLMs, multimodal models, agentic AI) and translate them into actionable product and design opportunities. Lead cross-functional initiatives where AI creates competitive differentiation. Build and facilitate AI training that upskills the design team
  • Building: Build systems, not one-off features—pipelines and agent-driven workflows that take in customer feedback, generate specs, prototype solutions, and ship. Design AI-powered experiences that people understand, value, use, and trust. Lead new ways of building product, such as unlocking designers to ship code in production
  • Accountability: Establish quality standards for AI-augmented work across your team. Define guardrails for AI-powered experiences that balance innovation with user trust. Own the outcomes not just of your own work, but the quality bar for how AI is used across the designers you influence. You can delegate the work, but never the accountability

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent expertise in User Experience, Interaction Design, Communication Design, Information Architecture, Psychology, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Human Factors, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise designing solutions for software, web applications, or mobile native apps
  • 3+ years of experience or equivalent expertise using industry-standard design and prototyping tools to create low- and high-fidelity designs, such as Figma
  • Deep proficiency with AI-powered design tools and workflows, with a track record of integrating AI capabilities into the design process and championing adoption across your team
  • Experience designing AI-powered features or products—such as conversational interfaces, intelligent recommendations, predictive workflows, or agentic experiences—with proven ability to ship to production with real outcomes
  • Demonstrated experience influencing, negotiating with, and gaining buy-in from stakeholders, including leadership
  • Demonstrated experience applying the design decision-making process and incorporating data and key findings into designs
  • Demonstrated experience supporting the iterative design process end-to-end, including wireframing, prototyping, user testing, and high-fidelity visuals
  • Foundational understanding of common design heuristics and principles
  • Ability to accept feedback gracefully while also knowing when to push back respectfully
  • Takes ownership of own work and AI-assisted outputs alike—being accountable to deadlines and to the quality of everything that ships, regardless of how it was produced
  • Delivers impactful presentations and uses storytelling to influence and persuade others
  • Can show examples of redesigning how design work gets done: abandoning the previous status quo and reinventing the process with AI at the core
  • Resume must include a link to your design portfolio

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent experience in User Experience, Interaction Design, Communication Design, Information Architecture, Psychology, HCI, Human Factors, or a related field
  • Experience shipping end-to-end AI workflows—not just conversational interfaces—to production with measurable outcomes
  • Proficiency with vibe coding and AI-assisted prototyping—using generative AI to rapidly bring design ideas to life in code
  • Experience evaluating and adopting emerging AI technologies to improve team productivity and design quality
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles including bias awareness, transparency, and user trust
  • Experience unlocking designers to ship code in production, with a clear understanding of the tradeoffs involved
  • A strong AI fluency trajectory—a clear story of how your AI practice has evolved, what you’ve tried and abandoned, and where you’re headed

raw.description:
Kategorie: Handel / Mode

Standort:


Stellen Sie sich eine Rolle vor, in der Ihre SAP SD Expertise nicht im Tagesgeschäft versickert, sondern spürbar Wirkung entfaltet. Ein Umfeld, in dem Sie Beschaffungsprozesse so gestalten können, dass sie in einer Organisation mit hunderten Märkten jeden Tag messbaren Unterschied machen.

Genau dort sucht unser Mandant – ein führendes, bekanntes deutsches Handelsunternehmen – Verstärkung in seinem internen Team als


SAP SD / Retail Inhouse (Senior) Berater (m/w/d)
wahlweise im Rheinland oder deutschlandweit aufgrund einer sehr arbeitnehmerfreundlichen Home-Office Regelung.
Warum diese Rolle gerade für erfahrene SD ExpertInnen interessant ist:

Sie landen nicht in einer endlosen Transformations-PowerPoint-Welt, sondern in einem kleinen, seniorigen Team, das seit Jahren gewachsen ist und pragmatisch arbeitet. Entscheidungen entstehen aus fachlicher Notwendigkeit, nicht aus politischer Dynamik. Es gibt kein Micromanagement, keine Silos, keine künstliche Hektik.

Sie arbeiten eigenständig, mit kurzen Wegen und realem Einfluss. Das Ganze auf Wunsch auch vertraglich zugesichert überwiegend remote. Etwa zwölf Präsenztage im Jahr reichen aus, um Workshops, Abstimmungen und Teamtermine sinnvoll zu begleiten.


Die Aufgabe: was Sie prägt

Sie bewegen sich fachlich klar im SAP-SD-Umfeld mit Fokus auf Kundenauftrags- und Vertriebsprozesse. Gleichzeitig gestalten Sie die Benutzer- und Rollenstrukturen, über die diese Prozesse im Alltag genutzt werden.

Konkret bedeutet das:
  • Sie beraten Fachbereiche, Entwickler und Product Owner und übersetzen fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige SD-Lösungen.
  • Sie verantworten Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung der SAP Build Work Zone, insbesondere Spaces, Pages, Rollen, Kataloge und Target Mappings über den SAP Content Manager bzw. das Fiori Launchpad.
  • Sie stellen sicher, dass Anwender genau die Anwendungen sehen, die sie für ihre Arbeit benötigen.
  • Sie begleiten Tests, Rollouts und Dokumentation in einem agilen Umfeld und sorgen für saubere Übergänge in den Betrieb.
  • Sie wirken aktiv an der S/4HANA-Transformation mit, ohne den Blick für den produktiven Alltag zu verlieren.

Sie sind dabei weder reiner Konzepter noch klassischer Ticketsachbearbeiter. Sie verbinden Prozessverständnis, Systemkenntnis und Nutzerperspektive. Und sehen unmittelbar, wie Ihre Arbeit im Alltag wirkt.


Was Sie mitbringen sollten

  • Starkes Fundament in SAP-Prozessen rund um Kundenauftragsprozesse und SAP SD
  • Erfahrung mit Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten, idealerweise im Kontext von Fiori sowie Spaces & Pages
  • Freude an strukturierter Prozessarbeit und daran, Komplexität beherrschbar zu machen
  • Erfahrung in agilen Projekt- oder Produktumfeldern ist hilfreich
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher (mind. C1 Level)

Branchenkenntnisse aus dem Handel oder im Rahmen einer S/4HANA-Transformation sind vorteilhaft, aber keine harte Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist Ihre fachliche Tiefe und Ihr Anspruch an Qualität.


Warum sich ein Wechsel lohnen kann

  • Echte Remote-Freiheit:Arbeiten Sie von überall, solange Sie für ca. 12 Tage/Jahr präsent sein können.
  • Stabile Organisation mit klarer Modernisierungsstrategie, ohne Transformations-Dauerstress
  • Ein kleines, senioriges Team: Kein politisches Labyrinth, kein Silodenken.
  • Arbeitszeit, die zu Ihrem Leben passt:37,5-h-Woche, flexible Zeiten, 30 Urlaubstage.
  • Unbefristet, langfristig, realistisch: Keine Luftschlösser – nur ein Umfeld, das Verlässlichkeit schätzt.

Der vielleicht wichtigste Punkt: Sie arbeiten in einem Umfeld, das nicht überladen ist. Verantwortung ist klar verteilt, Unterstützung selbstverständlich und fachliche Qualität wichtiger als Lautstärke.

​

Wenn Sie SAP SD nicht nur betreiben, sondern Prozesse und Benutzererlebnisse aktiv gestalten möchten, dann sollten wir sprechen. Gerne völlig unverbindlich im ersten Schritt.

Svante Freerksen
faktor s – Executive Search & HR Tech

raw.description:
Company Overview

Join us for an enriching journey with Outset, a trailblazing medical device company that is revolutionizing the field of dialysis. Our focus is to create one high performing team, obsessed with progress, in an atmosphere that is brimming with transformative opportunities. The heart of our mission is pioneering a groundbreaking technology that redefines the landscape of dialysis, streamlining complexity and cost, because patients deserve “better” now, not some day. 

At Outset we’re revolutionizing an industry and changing lives. We’re impacting what the future of dialysis looks like by creating a first-of-its-kind technology in order to reduce the cost and complexity of dialysis. FDA cleared for use across care settings, from the hospital to the clinic to the home, the Tablo® Hemodialysis System harnesses modern technology for a new holistic approach to dialysis care. We’re giving providers time back to focus on patient care. And we’re giving patients the power to take control of their life and get back to enjoying the things they love.

Position Overview

The National Accounts Director owns the enterprise growth strategy for assigned national health systems, converting contract access into system-wide adoption of Tablo across acute-care settings. This role serves as the quarterback for complex accounts: building executive alignment, establishing clear expansion priorities, removing barriers to facility-level engagement, and coordinating execution across regions and sites.

Success requires equal strength in strategy and follow-through. You'll create top-down and bottom-up account plans, lead C-suite and system-level relationships, and partner with Area Sales Managers and cross-functional teams to translate enterprise opportunity into measurable penetration, predictable revenue, and long-term customer value.

Own the Enterprise Account Strategy

National account growth begins with a clear view of how Outset creates the greatest system-wide value.

  • Develop and own strategic account plans for assigned national health systems, including facility targets, sequencing, growth milestones, and executive engagement priorities.
  • Assess system-level opportunity, installed-base performance, treatment pull-through, whitespace, competitive dynamics, and barriers to adoption.
  • Translate enterprise priorities into coordinated action plans for regions, facilities, and internal partners.
  • Maintain a clear view of account progress, risks, forecast, and next-best actions.

Create Access and Drive System-Wide Penetration

The opportunity is not simply to secure a contract; it is to convert enterprise access into sustained adoption across the system.

  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite, clinical, financial, operational, supply chain, and other system-level stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain national agreements and remove procurement, contracting, and access barriers that prevent facility-level engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Tablo into additional hospitals, service lines, and acute-care applications within assigned accounts.
  • Lead regular executive business reviews to assess performance, unlock new opportunities, and advance the relationship.
  • Track system-level penetration, treatment pull-through, expansion milestones, and progress against the account plan.

Quarterback Cross-Functional Execution

National accounts require one enterprise strategy and coordinated execution across many teams and geographies.

  • Align ASMs and field leadership on account priorities, facility sequencing, stakeholder engagement, and ownership.
  • Partner with Clinical Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Operations to support product launches, pricing, demonstrations, implementation, and expansion.
  • Provide field teams with clear account context, tools, resources, and executive air cover while maintaining ownership of the enterprise relationship and strategy.
  • Create scalable practices, references, and expansion approaches that apply across systems.

Build the Value Case and Negotiate

Complex health-system decisions require a compelling case for change and agreements that support durable growth.

  • Lead consultative discovery to understand system priorities, economics, decision dynamics, and adoption requirements.
  • Develop and present business cases, ROI models, and executive recommendations that demonstrate the value of Tablo.
  • Lead complex negotiations involving capital equipment, pricing, software, IT, cybersecurity, compliance, and long-term commercial terms.
  • Secure agreements and annual commitments that support predictable, mutually valuable growth.

Deliver Results

Strong national-account leadership is measured by both enterprise outcomes and disciplined execution.

  • Meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales objectives for assigned accounts.
  • Provide leadership with clear, actionable account plans, forecasts, risks, and progress updates.
  • Represent Outset with executive presence, integrity, sound judgment, and strong follow-through.
  • Comply with all company quality and commercial policies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Ten or more years of successful MedTech or complex healthcare sales experience, including at least five years in capital sales.
  • Demonstrated success growing large health-system or integrated delivery network accounts across multiple sites or regions.
  • Strong consultative-selling, contracting, negotiation, and executive-presentation capability.
  • Experience building alignment across C-suite, clinical, operational, financial, and procurement stakeholders while leading cross-functional work without direct authority.
  • Ability to travel up to 75%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading national or enterprise account strategy in hospitals, health systems, or integrated delivery networks.
  • Experience introducing disruptive technology and scaling adoption across multiple facilities.
  • Experience with software, analytics, EMR integration, or healthcare IT solutions.
  • Experience in dialysis, kidney care, or another complex capital-equipment market.
National Salary Range
National Salary Range (Remote)
$150,000—$150,000 USD

Company Culture

At Outset, we believe every person matters. Every Outsetter, every patient, every caregiver. Because we are here to create a revolution, and we believe in doing that by innovating everywhere with intelligent speed. Our team expects nothing less than our best display of strengths and skills, and we find joy in working together for a common goal. At Outset, we believe that curiosity, ingenuity and conviction in the power of technology will transform the lives of dialysis patients and providers.

We are fueled by the opportunity to give people their lives back. And we believe that it begins with YOU, our future Outsetter. At Outset, we’ve designed a professional world that our employees are honored and impassioned to belong to, one that offers challenge, the ability to collaborate with great people, and opportunities to build skill and expertise in a fulfilling career.

An opportunity at Outset Medical won’t just be about finding a job. Our culture revolves around the principles of moving farther, faster, together, so working here feels like a masterclass in peak performance, for individuals and teams.

Privacy is important to us. Please review our Applicant Privacy Notice.

Important Notice

We have been made aware of fraudulent activities where individuals are impersonating our company and offering fake job opportunities. Please note, Outset Medical will never request payment or gift cards during the hiring process, nor will we ask you to purchase your own equipment. Anyone reaching out to you with an email address ending in @outsetmedical.cc, is not a legitimate Outset representative. For legitimate opportunities, always apply directly through our official careers page. If you are unsure about the authenticity of a communication, contact us immediately at .

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Job Title:

Engagement Partner

Vice President, Client Services

Position Summary

The Director, Client Services, is a professional services leader responsible for the successful delivery of assigned accounts, programs, and projects across Red Clay's Delivery Practice. This role ensures engagements are completed on time, within budget, and to a standard of quality that drives client satisfaction and reference-ability. Serving as an Engagement Partner for identified client accounts, the Director partners with peer leaders and domain experts to sustain and expand long-term client relationships. In coordination with Executive Leadership, this role supports profitable, scalable growth through consistent delivery excellence and may contribute to business development efforts in support of net new client pursuits.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The following duties are representative of the work performed in this role. Other duties may be assigned as business needs to evolve.

Account/Project Performance and Operational Excellence

  • Own and deliver assigned projects to successful completion, ensuring adherence to the approved baseline, budget, schedule, scope, as sold margin, and all defined project KPIs

  • Supports the evolution, standardization, adoption, and efficiencies across the PMO organization

  • Knowledgeable of other methodology and implementation options in the industry, and able to support clients on the selection and implementation of those

  • Responsible for the Statements of Work, P&L, Change orders, project reporting, accuracy of KPIs, and invoice collections across assigned projects

  • Holds teams accountable for delivering operational excellence as it relates to timesheets, expenses, invoicing, and accuracy of reporting

  • Clear understanding of company financial models, pricing sheets, revenue, and margin goals

  • Enforce operating standards, methodologies, and best practices for delivery

  • Proactively monitor performance of assigned engagements and take action to protect project profit margins, outcomes, and client relationships

  • Inform and collaborate with the Delivery Executive for assigned engagements to ensure escalation, key decisions, and risks are communicated and handled appropriately

  • Improve project profit margins through standardization, documentation, creation of new collateral, reuse of assets, and operational discipline

  • Adopt Reddy AI agents and other proprietary tools to enhance service quality and delivery efficiency as applicable to assigned projects

  • Collaborate with the PMO to facilitate continuous improvement opportunities and standardization across the management of Advisory and Implementation projects

  • Presents and participates at industry events to showcase Red Clay's brand of Delivery excellence

Business Development – Sales Support

  • Participate in key sales pursuits, oral demonstrations, and executive presentations as assigned

Business Development – Account Expansion

  • Serve as an Account Owner/Engagement Partner for identified client accounts, driving account expansion by growing sold revenue (“bookings”) and realizing that revenue at or above agreed-upon targets

  • Interact with clients at the executive level and carry the perception of a leader across all levels of the client's organization

  • Understand the needs, roadmaps, challenges, and success opportunities for identified client accounts and position Red Clay as the preferred provider by connecting client needs to Red Clay's service offerings across practices and domains

  • Identify, qualify, and secure account expansion opportunities utilizing tools such as CRM and Kantata, as well as established Account Owner processes

  • Design and lead the contracting and negotiation process in a manner favorable to Red Clay's intended outcomes with the support of Practice leadership

  • Ensure all account expansion opportunities are aligned with capabilities, capacity, project profit margin targets, and corporate objectives by partnering and confirming with Practice Leadership

  • Maintain relationships with senior client executives within identified accounts to support long-term, multi-domain growth

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or related field; equivalent professional experience considered

  • 8+ years of professional services or consulting experience, including program/project management and client account ownership

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-workstream engagements on time and on budget with measurable client outcomes

  • Strong command of project financial management including P&L, margin analysis, SOW development, and change order management

  • Proven ability to build executive-level client relationships and drive account expansion, including identifying, qualifying, and closing growth opportunities

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification

  • Experience in a Director or equivalent leadership role within a consulting or advisory firm

  • Familiarity with PSA/project management tools such as Kantata and CRM platforms; experience with AI-enabled delivery tools a plus

Core Competencies

  • Ability to lead complex Program/Project engagements with on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes

  • Command of project financial management paired with experience supporting sales and driving account expansion

  • Ability to build and maintain executive-level client relationships that drive satisfaction and account expansion

  • Ability to partner effectively across practices, functions, and leadership levels

  • Clear, confident communication with the ability to influence stakeholders and present to clients

  • Oracle Energy & Water Program implementation experience

  • Business Development background & Sales methodology experience

Success Characteristics

Client Relationship Mastery

A successful Director, Client Services builds and sustains trusted advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders. They anticipate client needs before they are voiced, navigate complex organizational dynamics with ease, and consistently deliver commitments in ways that deepen loyalty and expand engagement.

Strategic Business Development Mindset

Success means identifying whitespace opportunities, connecting client challenges to practice capabilities, and actively contributing to pipeline development and proposal efforts. They think like a business owner, not just a service manager.

Delivery Excellence & Accountability

They hold themselves and their teams to high delivery standards. A successful director ensures engagements are scoped clearly, staffed appropriately, and executed with quality and efficiency. They course-correct proactively when engagements drift and protect both client outcomes and firm margins.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

They work fluidly across practice areas, operations, and leadership. They break down silos, connect dots between teams, and rally internal resources in service of client success — without needing formal authority to get things done.

Operational & Commercial Acumen

They understand the business of consulting utilization, margins, SOW management, and revenue recognition. They use tools like Kantata and CRM platforms fluently to keep delivery and business development data clean, current, and actionable.

Adaptive Communication

They flex their communication style for the audience, executive briefings, client workshops, internal stakeholders, or at-risk conversations. They are clear, credible, and composed, even in high-stakes situations.

Outcomes Orientation

They define success in terms of measurable client impact, not just activity. They set clear KPIs, track progress rigorously, and hold the line on scope in ways that protect value for both the client and the firm.

Resilience & Composure Under Pressure

Consulting engagements rarely go exactly to plan. A successful director stays steady when things get complicated, resourceful, solution-focused, and calm in moments that would unsettle a less seasoned leader.

Integrity & Professional Credibility

They show up consistently, follow through, and tell clients the truth.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This role operates primarily in a professional remote environment. The position requires the ability to work at a computer for extended periods and may involve travel to client sites, industry events, and Red Clay office locations as needed. Some evening or weekend availability may be required during critical project phases or business development activities.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued and respected.

raw.description:
was wir suchen

Du kannst verkaufen? Dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

Telefonieren kann jeder.

Verkaufen nicht.

Wir suchen keinen klassischen Vertriebsinnendienst, der Anfragen bearbeitet und Angebote verschickt. Wir suchen jemanden, der selbst den Hörer in die Hand nimmt, neue Kunden gewinnt und am Ende sagen kann:

„Den Auftrag habe ich geholt.“

Du bekommst von uns Vertriebsgebiete, in denen aktuell kein Außendienst unterwegs ist. Dein Job: Potenzielle Kunden identifizieren, anrufen, Interesse wecken, beraten – und abschließen.

deine aufgaben

Du gehst aktiv raus – nur eben per Telefon und Video.
Du sprichst potenzielle Neukunden an und führst den kompletten Vertriebsprozess selbstständig durch:

  • aktive Outbound-Telefonie und Neukundenakquise
  • Termine vereinbaren – und anschließend selbst durchführen
  • Beratung und Verkauf per Telefon oder Microsoft Teams
  • Bedarf erkennen, unsere Lösungen präsentieren und Einwände aus dem Weg räumen
  • dranbleiben, nachfassen und Abschlüsse machen
  • Bestandskunden aktiv auf weitere Lösungen wie das Patientenaufrufsystem oder unsere Web-App ansprechen
  • Teilweise Terminkoordination für den Außendienst, wenn der Kunde einen persönlichen Kontakt wünscht
  • Aushilfe im Innendienst-Team bei z.B. Anschlussverträgen oder vorzeitigen Verlängerungen unserer Bestandskunden

das bringst du mit

Du passt zu uns, wenn du …

  • Vertrieb auf höchstem Niveau beherrschst,
  • bereits nachweisbare Erfahrung im Direktvertrieb, Outbound-Sales oder Telefonvertrieb hast,
  • gerne telefonierst und keine Angst vor einem „Nein“ hast,
  • ehrgeizig bist und deine Ziele erreichen willst,
  • gerne selbstständig arbeitest und Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse übernimmst,
  • empathisch bist und den Kunden verstehst
Denn genau darum geht es bei dieser Position:
Neukunden gewinnen. Verkaufen. Abschließen.

was wir erwarten

Ganz wichtig:

Du musst Outbound wollen.

Wenn du darauf wartest, dass interessierte Kunden bei dir anrufen, wird das mit uns wahrscheinlich nichts.

Wenn du dagegen Spaß daran hast, selbst Türen zu öffnen, Menschen für ein Produkt zu begeistern und aus einem kalten Kontakt einen Kunden zu machen, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

das bieten wir

Das Wichtigste zuerst: 2.600 € Fixgehalt.
Dazu kommt eine attraktive erfolgsabhängige Provision von ca. 90.000€ pro Jahr bei erreichen der gesteckten Ziele. Nach oben hin ist alles offen!

Heißt also auch:

Wie viel du am Ende verdienst, hast du zu einem guten Teil selbst in der Hand.
Wir suchen ausdrücklich Menschen, die genau das attraktiv finden.

Zusätzlich kannst Du mit folgendem rechnen:

- 30 Tage Urlaub
- betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- ​ÖPNV-Zuschuss
- EGYM-Wellpass
- Firmenfahrrad
- Corporate Benefits
- Kinderbetreuungszuschuss
- VWL
​- ​Firmenleasing neuester Hardware (auch für Privat)
​

und noch einiges mehr!

raw.title: Director Demand Generation
raw.excerpt: Our Story: Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc.  (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services.
raw.description:
Our Story:

Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc. (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services. Our programs teach professionals the skills to recognize, prevent, and respond to crises in the workplace. Since 1980, we’ve helped train more than 17 million people across service‑oriented industries including education, health care, behavioral health, long‑term care, human services, security, corporate, and retail.
At CPI, we are dedicated to changing behaviors and reducing conflict for the Care, Welfare, Safety, and Security of everyone. We believe empathy, meaningful connections, personal safety, and security are the antidotes to fear and anxiety. This philosophy is central to everything we do and traces back to our beginning.

As a member of the team, you can expect to:
  • Make a difference through your work — You’ll be proud to tell your family and friends what you do.
  • Gain significant career experience within a fast‑growing organization — From entry‑level roles to executive leadership.
  • Feel fulfilled and have fun — We work hard but make time to build meaningful relationships and celebrate wins.
The Role:
As we evolve our marketing organization, we're looking for a hands-on Director of Demand Generation to build a more modern, integrated approach to creating and converting demand.

This is a builder-doer role. You'll set the direction for CPI's demand generation function, but you'll also be deeply involved in doing the work: developing campaigns, building ABM programs, designing audience journeys, digging into performance, partnering with Sales, and showing the team what great demand generation looks like. Many of the capabilities required for a mature demand engine, including segmentation, data, technology, lifecycle infrastructure, and measurement, are being built in parallel, so you'll need to make meaningful progress with what exists today while helping define what comes next.

Over time, the role will evolve as our capabilities, team, data, and technology mature. Initially, we're looking for someone who is excited to build while doing, not someone expecting to lead an already-established demand generation engine.

What You Get to Do Every Day:

Build & Execute CPI’s Demand Strategy
  • Develop and execute demand plans across priority markets, audiences, accounts, and revenue opportunities, connecting integrated campaigns, always-on programs, ABM, lifecycle marketing, events, paid media, content, and organic channels.
  • Personally build early programs alongside the team, from audience and journey development through briefs, activation, testing, measurement, and optimization.
  • Make recommendations about where CPI should invest, test, scale, change, or stop based on business opportunity and performance.
  • Establish the planning processes, channel frameworks and operating rhythms that allow the function to become increasingly sophisticated over time.
Build Toward Account-Based & Audience-Led Demand
  • Build CPI toward a scalable ABM capability, partnering with Sales, Product Marketing, Industry Marketing, and Marketing Operations to establish the audiences, account strategies, processes, and infrastructure required over time.
  • Develop and execute practical early account-based plays using the capabilities and data available today, while identifying what needs to be built to enable more sophisticated ABM.
  • As CPI’s segmentation, ICPs, buyer insights, account data, and technology mature, translate them into increasingly sophisticated audience, buying-group, journey, and activation strategies.
  • Build strong day-to-day alignment with Sales around priority accounts and opportunities, account engagement, demand quality, follow-up, and what Marketing is learning.
Build Integrated Campaigns & Audience Journeys
  • Personally lead the development of integrated campaign plans. Own the integrated campaign architecture and customer journey, bringing together the market, audience, message, content, channel, conversion, and measurement inputs required to create and convert demand.
  • Connect content, paid media, organic social, sponsored programs, events, email, web, sales activation, and other touchpoints into a cohesive journey rather than a collection of channel tactics.
  • Work alongside the team on early campaigns to establish strong briefs, content and journey plans, channel roles, measurement, and ways of working that can become repeatable over time.
Measure, Learn & Build the Team
  • Dig into program and audience performance to understand what's working, what isn't, and what CPI should do differently, even while our measurement capabilities are still evolving.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to build toward stronger visibility into qualified demand, account engagement, opportunities, pipeline, revenue, and marketing efficiency.
  • Lead and develop a team spanning performance marketing, content, design, and events, working alongside them to establish what good looks like and build their capabilities.
  • Determine where AI, agencies, technology, and external specialists can increase the team's capabilities, quality, and speed.

You Need to Have:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Product Management, or related field
  • 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in demand generation, growth marketing, integrated marketing, or revenue marketing.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to build and develop high-performing teams.
  • Experience building and executing integrated demand programs across multiple channels and knowledge how to move from audience and business opportunity through activation, conversion, measurement, and optimization.
  • Hands-on experience building account-based programs and working with Sales around target accounts, buying groups, engagement, and pipeline.
  • Experience with complex, multi-stakeholder B2B purchases rather than primarily transactional lead generation.
  • Experience building or significantly evolving a demand generation capability in an imperfect environment.
  • Experience creating structure where it doesn’t exist, developing people while working alongside them, and making progress without pristine data, technology, processes, or attribution.

We’d Love to See:
  • Experience leading a team and managing meaningful marketing investment, agencies, and external partners.
  • Strong analytical judgement and cross-functional leadership.
  • Familiarity with lifecycle marketing, conversion optimization, and modern AI-enabled marketing practices.

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • 401k
  • PTO
  • Health & Wellness Days
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Continuing education and training
  • Hybrid / Remote work schedule
  • Paid Parental Leave
Crisis Prevention Institute is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of age, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, or expression (including against any individual that is transitioning, has transitioned, or is perceived to be transitioning), marital status or civil partnership/union status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, childbirth, genetic information, military and veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law. The Company will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, and general treatment during employment.

raw.description:
Du bist im DevOps-Umfeld zu Hause, hast Freude an technischen Herausforderungen und möchtest gleichzeitig Verantwortung für Menschen und Projekte übernehmen?

Du verstehst dich nicht als Führungskraft, die ausschließlich koordiniert, sondern möchtest auch selbst Architekturentscheidungen treffen, technische Lösungen entwickeln und dein Team im Projektalltag unterstützen? Dann könnte diese Position genau zu dir passen.

Für ein etabliertes Digitalisierungs- und Technologieunternehmen suchen wir einen Team Lead DevOps & Cloud Solutions (m/w/d), der fachliche und disziplinarische Führung mit fundierter technischer Expertise verbindet.

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für ein kleines, erfahrenes Team mit unterschiedlichen Schwerpunkten in den Bereichen Development, DevOps, Architektur und IT-Consulting. Der Bereich befindet sich weiterhin im Aufbau und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, Strukturen, Best Practices und das Leistungsportfolio aktiv mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

Teamführung und Weiterentwicklung

  • Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines erfahrenen Teams.
  • Du stabilisierst die Zusammenarbeit, schaffst klare Strukturen und unterstützt bei fachlichen und organisatorischen Herausforderungen.
  • Du etablierst Best Practices für Zusammenarbeit, technische Qualität und den Umgang mit parallel laufenden Projekten.
  • Du förderst die individuellen Kompetenzen deines Teams und entwickelst den Bereich gemeinsam mit der Abteilungsleitung weiter.

Hands-on im technischen Projektgeschäft

  • Du arbeitest selbst aktiv in Kundenprojekten mit und verbindest technische Beratung mit praktischer Umsetzung.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption, Implementierung und Optimierung moderner DevOps- und Cloud-Lösungen.
  • Du bringst deine Expertise in den Bereichen DevOps, SecDevOps, Cloud-Infrastrukturen und Automatisierung ein.
  • Du unterstützt dein Team bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen und sorgst für nachhaltige, praxistaugliche Lösungen.

Projektentwicklung und Pre-Sales

  • Du identifizierst gemeinsam mit der Abteilungsleitung neue Projektpotenziale bei bestehenden Kunden.
  • Du erkennst Möglichkeiten für Cross-Selling und den Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen.
  • Du bewertest technische Anforderungen und schätzt Aufwände sowie Umsetzbarkeit realistisch ein.
  • Du wirkst an der Entwicklung passender Leistungsangebote mit und unterstützt bei der Gewinnung neuer Projekte.

Dabei arbeitest du in einem dynamischen Projektumfeld, in dem mehrere Kundenprojekte parallel laufen können und neue Aufgaben nicht immer langfristig planbar sind.

Qualifikationen

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im DevOps-, Cloud- or Infrastrukturumfeld.
  • Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung von Mitarbeitenden oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Führungsrolle.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in DevOps und idealerweise SecDevOps.
  • Praxiserfahrung mit Kubernetes, Helm, Ansible und Python.
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS und/oder Microsoft Azure.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Architektur, Automatisierung, IT-Security und moderne Softwareentwicklungsprozesse.
  • Die Fähigkeit, technische Aufwände und Risiken einzuschätzen und daraus belastbare Projektangebote abzuleiten.
  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen technischen Spezialist unterschiedlicher Fachrichtungen.
  • Eine pragmatische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen Orientierung zu geben.

Benefits

Führung mit technischem Gestaltungsspielraum

Du kombinierst Teamverantwortung mit eigener technischer Arbeit. Die Rolle ist bewusst so angelegt, dass du sowohl Menschen entwickelst als auch bei anspruchsvollen technischen Themen mitwirkst.

Ein Team mit Erfahrung und Potenzial

Du übernimmst ein Team mit unterschiedlichen technischen Kompetenzen und kannst die Zusammenarbeit sowie die fachliche Ausrichtung aktiv weiterentwickeln.

Gestaltung statt starrer Strukturen

Der Bereich befindet sich weiterhin im Aufbau. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Prozesse, Best Practices und das Leistungsportfolio mitzugestalten.

Abwechslungsreiches Projektgeschäft

Du arbeitest an unterschiedlichen Kundenprojekten, begleitest technische Lösungsansätze und entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Abteilungsleitung neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

Direkte Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe

Dich erwartet ein pragmatisches Umfeld mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen und einer direkten Zusammenarbeit mit der Abteilungsleitung.

Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen

raw.description:
Vericast is investing in the next generation of Advanced Analytics, Experimentation, and Measurement, and we're looking for a Principal Data Scientist to help lead the way. This is a highly visible opportunity for a data science leader who thrives at the intersection of experimentation, causal inference, machine learning, and Generative AI.

In this role, you'll shape our analytics discipline from the ground up, partnering with executive leaders and cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges with data. You'll design rigorous experimentation frameworks, build and deploy scalable AI and machine learning solutions, and transform complex insights into clear recommendations that drive growth and measurable business impact.

This is a senior individual contributor role that offers the opportunity to influence strategy, establish best practices, mentor other data scientists, and leave a lasting mark on how Vericast leverages data to make decisions.

What You'll Do

Lead Experimentation & Measurement Strategy (40%)

  • Own the end-to-end design, execution, and analysis of marketing and product experiments, including A/B, multivariate, geo, and holdout testing.
  • Define and manage the experimentation roadmap, including hypothesis development, prioritization, power analysis, and success metrics.
  • Develop and refine methodologies for lift measurement, incrementality testing, and causal inference.
  • Establish standards, governance, and best practices that ensure statistical rigor and actionable insights across the organization.
  • Partner with stakeholders to build a culture of experimentation and data-driven decision making.

Drive Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning & GenAI Innovation (40%)

  • Design, build, validate, and deploy machine learning and Generative AI solutions using large-scale structured and unstructured data.
  • Develop predictive, prescriptive, attribution, market mix, and uplift models that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead hands-on model development, coding, testing, and production deployment while establishing technical standards for the broader team.
  • Create and maintain robust data pipelines to ensure data quality, integrity, and scalability.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and analytical approaches to improve performance and business value.

Influence the Business Through Strategic Partnership (20%)

  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Sales, IT, Risk, and Compliance teams to identify, prioritize, and solve high-value business opportunities.
  • Translate complex business challenges into testable hypotheses and analytical solutions.
  • Present findings and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences in a clear and compelling way.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on experimentation, analytics, AI, and machine learning.
  • Mentor and elevate fellow data scientists through coaching, technical guidance, and best-practice sharing.

Education

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field required.
  • PhD in Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline strongly preferred.
  • Relevant data science, machine learning, or cloud certifications are a plus.

Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in data science, analytics, or machine learning roles with significant hands-on experience working with large-scale data environments.
  • Experience within financial services or another highly regulated, data-intensive industry preferred.
  • Proven success leading or serving as a senior technical contributor on experimentation, measurement, and advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven insights and recommendations.

What Will Make You Successful

Experimentation, Measurement & Statistical Expertise

  • Deep expertise in marketing experimentation, including A/B testing, multivariate testing, experimental design, metric development, and lift/incrementality measurement.
  • Strong background in causal inference methodologies, hypothesis testing, statistical modeling, and power analysis.
  • Proven ability to design, execute, validate, and scale experimentation programs that enable confident business decision-making.
  • Experience establishing governance, best practices, and standards for experimentation across an organization.

Machine Learning, GenAI & Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying Market Mix Models (MMM), Attribution Models, and Uplift Models.
  • Strong experience working with Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI solutions, and emerging agent-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangSmith, or similar technologies.
  • Expertise in machine learning techniques including clustering, classification, regression, neural networks, anomaly detection, recommendation engines, and predictive modeling.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python, Spark/PySpark, and SQL.
  • Experience working with modern cloud-based data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar data lake environments.
  • Experience building and deploying solutions within AWS and Azure cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with containerization and development tools including Kubernetes, Docker, and Git.
  • Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools, with Tableau preferred.
  • Familiarity with data science platforms such as Dataiku is a plus.

Leadership & Communication

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments while driving clarity, prioritization, and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex analytical concepts into practical, executive-level recommendations.
  • Experience mentoring and providing technical leadership to data scientists and analytics professionals.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven success collaborating across Product, Marketing, Sales, IT, Risk, Compliance, and other business functions.
  • Passion for fostering a data-driven culture built on rigorous experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Salary Range: $170,000 - $200,000

Position is eligible for an annual bonus incentive program

Applications will be accepted until the posted deadline of November 13, 2026, or until a sufficient candidate pool has been identified.

WHAT WE BELIEVE
At Vericast, we believe what’s good for people is good for business. Everything we do starts from a place of
purpose to drive meaningful impact for our clients, our people and our communities.

We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, a heritage of innovation and a focus on workplace flexibility.
Every day you will have the opportunity to bring your passion and expertise to create opportunities to grow

and thrive.

Together, let’s advance performance for all.

At Vericast, we don’t just accept differences - we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our clients, and our community. As an Equal Opportunity employer, Vericast considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classifications protected by law. Applicants who have disabilities may request that accommodations be made in order to complete the selection process by contacting our Talent Acquisition team at . EEO is the law. Description

We are hiring a Senior DFT Engineer in Europe to own Design-for-Test on customer SoCs end-to-end: DFT architecture, scan/ATPG, memory BIST, boundary scan, pattern validation and production test hand-off.

The company provides end-to-end ASIC and COT design and turnkey manufacturing services to fabless companies and OEMs building advanced SoCs. Its offering covers architecture, RTL-to-GDSII implementation, analog/mixed-signal design, and productization through silicon, package, and test. Working across process nodes from 180nm to 2nm, it has completed over 350 tape-outs since 1986

Requirements

Must-Have Requirements:

  • BSc in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on DFT experience — must. Senior-level profiles preferred.
  • DFT methodologies: scan, ATPG, at-speed test, memory BIST, I/O DFT.
  • Scan insertion and ATPG for stuck-at, transition-delay, bridging and IDDQ fault models; test-coverage improvement.
  • DFT DRC analysis and coverage debug with Synopsys DFT Compiler / TestMAX (TetraMAX) / SpyGlass DFT or equivalent Siemens (Mentor) Tessent tools.
  • Memory BIST — Tessent MBIST.
  • Strong knowledge of JTAG IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1149.6 and IEEE 1500 (formerly P1500).
  • Hands-on design and implementation of DFT features.
  • End-to-end DFT flow ownership: concept → tape-out → production.
  • Gate-level simulation setup and runs (pattern validation).
  • Formal equivalence checking.
  • Perl / Tcl / UNIX scripting for flow automation.

Nice to Have

  • Broader Siemens Tessent experience (ScanPro / TestKompress, LBIST) beyond MBIST.
  • Advanced-node experience (7nm and below).
  • Python for flow automation.

raw.title: Senior / Principal Power Systems Engineer
raw.excerpt: Reporting to the Director of Power Systems Modeling, you will serve as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for transmission planning and generation interconnection.
raw.description:
Reporting to the Director of Power Systems Modeling, you will serve as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for transmission planning and generation interconnection. This is a high-impact technical role where your deep understanding of power systems will not only drive complex study work but also serve as the "blueprint" for our software development team. You are the bridge between traditional electrical engineering and modern digital transformation. You are also expected to contribute towards the successful completion of a range of consulting projects focused on power system planning studies involving Steady-State, Short Circuit, Transient Stability, Generator and Renewables Interconnections, Large Loads and Data Centers, Electromagnetic Transients (EMT), Model Quality Tests (MQT) and benchmarking, Power System Economics, Market Analysis, and Grid Resilience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute Complex Power System Studies: Lead and perform advanced transmission planning and generation interconnection studies (System Impact, Feasibility, and Deliverability) across multiple North American markets (WECC, PJM, MISO, ERCOT, SPP, SERC, etc.).
  • Technical Authority on Interconnection: Act as the lead expert for both large-scale generation (including IBR) and large-load interconnection requests, navigating the specific tariff and reliability requirements of various RTOs/ISOs.
  • Product Strategy & SME Support: Collaborate directly with our software engineers to translate complex engineering workflows into automated tools. You will define the logic, "teach" the software team the engineering nuances, and validate the output of our internal automation frameworks.
  • Advanced Modeling: Build, tune, and validate high-quality power system models for steady-state, short circuit, transient stability, and EMT analyses using industry-standard tools.
  • Automation Mindset: While we have dedicated software developers, you will be expected to use Python and SQL to automate your own workflows and prototype new ideas that can be scaled into production-level software.
  • Support Business Growth: Collaborate with the leadership team to develop and implement strategies for expanding our consulting services, including identifying emerging needs and new market opportunities and service offerings.
  • Engage with Stakeholders: Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including utilities, RTOs, project developers, and regulatory bodies, to advocate for and advance Simple Thread’s projects.
  • Innovate and Improve: Lead the development of innovative methodologies and tools that enhance power systems analysis and streamline processes for both internal and client use.
  • Mentor and Lead: Guide and instruct team members using a strong technical understanding of generation (including IBR), transmission, interconnection, customer and load, and modeling principles.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all study work and automated processes adhere strictly to NERC and regional reliability standards.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with a focus on Power Systems; a Master’s or PhD degree is highly preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in transmission planning, interconnection studies, EMT analyses likely gained within a utility, RTO, or specialized consulting firm.
  • Market Versatility: Proven track record of navigating the study processes and TARA/PSSE/PSCAD modules for multiple regions (e.g. ERCOT MQT, PJM GD, MISO RIST, CAISO GD, etc.).
  • Tool Proficiency: Expert-level command of PSSE, TARA, PSLF, PSCAD, EMTP, and PowerWorld.
  • Coding Literacy: Proficiency in Python is required for workflow automation. While you don't need to be a full-stack developer, you must be comfortable reading/writing scripts and eager to work in a software-centric environment.
  • Load & Generation Expertise: Deep knowledge of both traditional generation and the unique challenges of Inverter-Based Resources (IBR) and large industrial load and data centers integration.
  • Communication: The ability to distill highly technical engineering concepts into clear requirements for software developers and actionable insights for clients.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with PowerGEM TARA’s automation API.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with EM/ES interferences, grounding (GPR, step & touch) analysis using CDEGS,
  • Familiarity with arc flash analysis using ETAP

Join Us:

Simple Thread offers an opportunity to be at the forefront of technological innovation in the energy industry. We are looking for someone who shares our passion for making a difference and is ready to tackle the challenges of integrating software solutions with energy systems. If you’re passionate about power systems, driven by growth, and eager to make an impact, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

A Great Team – Our team is the best part of working here. We only hire people who are fantastic teammates – competent and smart, sure, but also humble, positive, and generous.

Great Clients – We work with mostly small and medium clients, for whom our projects make a huge impact. We prioritize clients who are pleasant and good to work with, people who share our values of transparency and empathy.

Work From Home – We are a distributed company. Everyone works from home.

Flexible Work Schedule – We require a certain amount of overlap with the rest of the team, but if you have a predictable schedule, we can probably support it, e.g., ending at 3:30 every day or being out every Friday morning.

Good Work Life Balance (really) – We ask our team to work 40 hours a week*. That’s all: a good, productive 40 hours. And then we try our best to leave you alone off the clock. We do this in part because that’s how we want to live but also because we want our team to be recharged and ready to do their best when working. *If you need to work fewer than 40 hours, that might be possible too; let’s talk.

Competitive Compensation – We offer highly competitive salary and benefits, including generous time off, pension plan (401k or RRSP), FSA, medical and dental insurance, support for continuous growth and professional development. We hire remotely and adjust compensation to meet individual needs, but the standard salary range for this role is $145,000 to $225,000, varying highly with individual experience and strengths.

Simple Thread values diversity in all of its forms, and we hire the best person we can for each role, no matter your personal background. Research tells us that applicants who are female or non-binary, as well as applicants who are people of color, are less likely to apply for roles they do not feel 100% qualified for. If you think you meet more than 50% of our requirements but fewer than 100% of them, please apply. We’re imperfect communicators, so think of our job postings as the starting point for discussion rather than proof that you shouldn’t apply.

About the team / Role

In today's software development landscape, collaboration, E2E accountability, problem solving and streamlined workflows are key to achieving efficiency and delivering high-quality solutions that solve customer problems and generate business outcomes. We believe in the power of integrated engineering, where development, quality, and agility skills blend together throughout the solution delivery pipeline. In this role, you'll be a champion for this approach, fostering a culture of shared ownership and breaking down silos to ensure a smooth and efficient flow of innovation to customers.

How you'll make an impact

  • Collaborate with stakeholders throughout the SDLC to translate requirements into high-quality, reliable, cost-effective, and maintainable solutions that solve customer problems and generate business outcomes.
  • Design, develop, and implement high quality software components with a focus on Continuous Delivery principles and practices.
  • Champion integrated engineering practices within the organization, fostering collaboration and shared ownership between development, operations, and security teams. Deliver technical and administrative support for live applications, promoting automation and proactive monitoring and self-recoverability, rapid incident response, and continuous improvement.
  • Analyze existing systems and processes to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvements to flow.

  • Full-Stack / Backend Development:Design, develop, test, and deploy clean, maintainable, and efficient code using Java and JavaScript.
  • Database Management: Write optimized queries, design data schemas, and manage both relational (MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL database integrations.
  • Component Design: Apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS) principles and design patterns to translate functional requirements into scalable technical modules.
  • Algorithm & Data Structure Application: Select and implement optimal data structures and algorithms to solve performance bottlenecks and ensure low-latency system behavior.
  • Collaboration & Code Reviews: Actively participate in peer code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions to lift code quality and team standards.
  • SystemQuality & Reliability: Write unit, integration, and functional tests to maintain high code coverage and minimize production defects.

Core Skills:

  • Programming/Software Development: This skill remains the foundation. Proficiency in programming languages and development methodologies is essential for designing, developing, and implementing software components in an integrated engineering environment. A strong focus on continuous delivery practices is crucial.
  • Testing Quality assurance is paramount. The ability to design, execute, and analyze various types of tests to ensure deployments meet established acceptance criteria remains essential.
  • Requirements Management : Understanding requirements throughout the software delivery lifecycle is critical. This ensures alignment with business needs, avoids rework, and fosters collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Software Design: While automation might play a larger role in integrated engineering, a combined understanding of software development practices and design principles is still valuable. This ensures creating maintainable, scalable, and secure applications.
  • Measurement: Data-driven decision making is crucial. The ability to define and establish measurement frameworks, along with KPIs related to software delivery and performance, helps identify areas for improvement.

Additional Valuable Skills:

  • Configuration Management: Managing configurations with IaC tools is essential for consistent and repeatable deployments. However, the specific emphasis on configuration management might be slightly lower since integrated engineering often emphasizes infrastructure automation.
  • Application Support : While IT Service Support (SERV) covers some aspects of application support, this skill can be relevant if the role has a stronger focus on troubleshooting and supporting specific applications.
  • Systems Integration: While integration activities might be streamlined, understanding system integration principles can be valuable, especially if the role involves integrating various software components.
  • Release and Deployment Management: Effectively managing software releases and deployments is crucial. However, in an integrated engineering environment, automation tools and streamlined processes might reduce the manual effort involved compared to traditional release cycles.
  • Methods and Tools : The right tools automate tasks, improve decision-making, and ensure consistent practices. This is crucial for efficiency, data-driven development, and staying current in a rapidly evolving field.

Experience you will bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in software engineering and delivery.
  • Strong understanding of continuous delivery principles and practices.
  • Exposure to Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficiency in multiple programming languages and technologies (Java, JavaScript, Python).
  • Familiarity with Java frameworks such as Spring Boot or Hibernate.
  • Thorough understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS) concepts (Abstraction, Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism).
  • Strong foundation in Data Structures & Algorithms (Arrays, Linked Lists, Trees, Graphs, Hashing, Sorting/Searching).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.

Job Description:

PairSoft is looking for a quality leader who sees QA as a strategic function — not a gate at the end of a delivery cycle, but a discipline that runs through how software is designed, built, and operated. You will lead an existing team of 15 -20 members and take ownership of both the quality function and a broader mandate around process improvement across the engineering organization.
We are looking for someone who brings their own point of view on where the friction is and how to reduce it — not someone who waits to be told what to fix.

Location: PAN India ( remote)

Responsibilities / Essential Functions

  • Lead and develop a QA team of 15 -20 across multiple product lines, setting quality standards and building a culture of engineering discipline.
  • Define and own the testing strategy across the portfolio — spanning functional, regression, integration, and non-functional quality dimensions.
  • Identify and drive process improvement initiatives across the engineering organization, with a focus on measurable outcomes over process theater.
  • Establish metrics and reporting that give leadership meaningful visibility into quality trends, not just pass/fail counts.
  • Work across ERP integration surfaces and enterprise deployment contexts to ensure quality standards account for the complexity of the customer environments PairSoft operates in.
  • Build a team capable of scaling with the organization — developing talent, closing skill gaps, and raising the floor across the QA function.

Requirements

The right candidate will have a track record in quality leadership within enterprise software — not consumer applications, not early-stage startups and not consulting projects. The complexity of enterprise environments, long release cycles, and integration-heavy architectures is where this person should feel at home.

  • Significant experience leading QA teams in enterprise software organizations, with direct ownership of quality outcomes across multiple products or platforms.
  • A point of view on process improvement that goes beyond quality — someone who has looked at how engineering organizations work and found better ways to sequence, coordinate, or structure that work.
  • Familiarity with financial software environments — understanding the stakes of defects in systems that touch financial transactions, document integrity, or compliance workflows.
  • Experience working with or around ERP ecosystems, where integration complexity and customer environment variability create non-trivial quality challenges.
  • The ability to operate at both a strategic and a working level — comfortable defining a testing philosophy and equally comfortable getting into the detail when it matters.
  • Strong communication skills across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders — able to translate quality data into business-relevant narrative.

Work and Physical Requirements

This position may work from home and/or office environment. Working in an office environment may require prolonged sitting, work in an air-conditioned environment, ability to work with others at various noise levels and ability to lift up to 30 pounds or 15 kg.

Other Duties

This job description is not intended to be a complete list of responsibilities. Other duties may be assigned by management that may reasonably fit in the scope of job.

Position Purpose: Responsible for building and governing the enterprise knowledge foundation that powers AI-generated insights. This role oversees the capture, curation, structure, and lifecycle management of business knowledge, ensuring organizational expertise, business processes, policies, rules, and contextual information are transformed into trusted, AI-consumable assets. The leader is accountable for enterprise knowledge strategy and execution, data governance, metadata strategy, and content that powers the AI context layer. The leader will serve as a strategic bridge between business teams, analytics organizations, and engineering partners to ensure enterprise knowledge is accurate, current, discoverable, and aligned with authoritative sources of truth. The leader will drive strategic advantage from enterprise knowledge assets to position the organization at the forefront of AI-enabled decision-making and agentic production.

AI Content Development and Strategic Execution

  • Own Enterprise Knowledge Strategy and AI Content Management, balancing strategic vision with operational execution to transform institutional knowledge into a strategic asset that creates competitive advantage and accelerates AI adoption.
  • Identify, document, and transform critical institutional knowledge into scalable information assets, developing and maintaining domain-specific knowledge bases that include business context, taxonomies, knowledge-to-data mappings, and metric standards.
  • Establish an information lifecycle management framework for knowledge assets designed to intake, curate, validate, evolve, and retire content while preserving integrity and minimizing bias through drift prevention, relevance management, and continuous validation.
  • Partner with technology teams to map institutional knowledge and information assets to trusted data sources that power generative and agentic AI solutions
  • Possess AI literacy and apply conceptual knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and content optimization techniques to structure information assets for retrieval accuracy and AI effectiveness.

Influence, Collaboration, and Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data engineering, analytics, and business leadership to ensure alignment and prioritization of AI content knowledge creation and data governance efforts.
  • Discover and translate AI business needs and use cases into explicit knowledge requirements by domain, and partner to gather and document key information into reusable AI context assets
  • Communicate on progress, barriers, opportunities, and outcomes surrounding knowledge strategy and governance policies to senior leadership and other key stakeholders.

Embedded Data Governance

  • Maintain a robust data governance framework to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security in all Data Products, Analytics Products, and AI insights.
  • Enable data users by maintaining a dynamic data and metrics catalogue, providing enablement and training opportunities, and offering issue support and resolution.
  • Partner with data engineering to close data quality gaps and embed governance early in data layer creation.
  • Foster a culture of data stewardship and accountability throughout the organization.
  • Ensure data and knowledge assets are leveraged effectively to enable Centene's business and AI goals.
  • Develop and enforce data ownership policies, usage standards, and best practices across the organization.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead, grow, and develop a high-performing team of data governance specialists and data analysts.
  • Guide and align individual and team level goals to organizational strategic direction.
  • Provide mentorship and professional development opportunities to team members.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and innovation across the data organization and in the business units.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Comply with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 10+ years of related experience, including prior management experience.
  • Prior healthcare and/or managed care industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.
Pay Range: $171,900.00 - $326,900.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status.
