About Priority:

Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

The Director, Sales leads Prisma’s enterprise sales strategy across the multifamily rental housing & HOA industry. This role owns new logo acquisition, pipeline development, forecasting, and the systems needed to scale revenue. The leader will both build the sales organization and personally close large multifamily operators and ownership groups.

Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership & Strategy

  • Own Prisma’s new-business strategy within the multifamily rental housing & HOA ecosystem.

  • Build and manage the sales team (SDRs/AEs) with clear KPIs and accountability.

  • Develop a disciplined enterprise sales process for multi-property, high-value deals.

  • Pipeline Development.

  • Drive top-of-funnel growth through outbound programs, partnerships, events, and referrals.

  • Maintain high-quality pipeline metrics, forecasting accuracy, and CRM discipline.

Enterprise Sales Execution

  • Player / Coach

  • Personally close strategic accounts (1,000+ units).

  • Lead conversations with owners, COOs, VPs of Operations, IT leaders, and procurement.

  • Manage complex sales cycles involving PMS integrations, payment workflows, resident banking features, and rev-share structures.

  • Build compelling ROI analyses tailored to multifamily operations and financial outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align with Marketing on demand generation and messaging.

  • Partner with Client Success for smooth close → onboarding → adoption.

  • Coordinate with Product/Engineering on roadmap feedback from multifamily operators.

  • Collaborate with Finance on pricing, rev-share models, and revenue planning.

Systems & Process

  • Implement scalable systems for outreach, sequencing, demos, proposals, and forecasting.

  • Develop CRM KPIs and manage each with the team to ensure accuracy, discipline, and accountability.

  • Maintain competitive awareness within the multifamily PropTech landscape (Bilt, Livly, PMS providers, etc.).

What Success Looks Like:

We're looking for someone who is energized by building relationships and creating new opportunities. The successful candidate is naturally curious, highly competitive, and motivated by helping organizations solve complex business challenges through innovative technology. They are confident presenting to executive leadership, resilient throughout the sales process, and passionate about the sports and entertainment industry.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing Sports & Entertainment team and play a key role in expanding Priority Commerce's presence across professional sports, collegiate athletics, leagues, venues, and entertainment organizations. You'll work alongside industry veterans while helping shape the future of commerce within one of the company's fastest-growing verticals.

Candidate Requirements:

  • 7+ years enterprise SaaS, PropTech, FinTech, or payments sales experience.

  • 5+ Experience in Rent/ HOA payments.

  • Proven success selling into multifamily property management companies or ownership groups.

  • Previous Startup/scale-up experience.

  • Strong command of long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

  • Experience building or scaling a sales team.

  • Excellent executive communication and negotiation skills.

  • Strong analytical background for KPIs, dashboards, and revenue modeling.

  • Ability to navigate procurement, legal terms, and revenue-share agreements.

Preferred

  • Experience in banking, payments, payables, leasing.

  • Familiarity with B2B2C property management models.

  • Understanding of payment security, compliance, and resident data requirements.

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:

Compensation range:$144k -$167k

We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Financial Wellness

  • 401(k) match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

Health & Well-being

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.

raw.title: Helpline Contact Center Supervisor
raw.excerpt: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.
raw.description:
Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.

In 1957, The Medical Foundation (TMF) was created to primarily fund biomedical research in Massachusetts. Since then, we’ve been on a journey of evolution. We changed our name to Health Resources in Action (HRiA) to reflect our impact in the field of public health. Today, HRiA works with individuals, organizations, and communities to drive a policy and systems change approach to advance health and racial equity.

HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

  • Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.
  • Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.
  • Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.
  • Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 270 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.

As part of our Public Health Services, HRiA manages an extensive portfolio of behavioral health initiatives, including statewide substance use helplines in Vermont and Oregon and substance use and problem gambling helplines in Massachusetts and Illinois. The Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) was launched in 2017, building upon our experience operating the MA Substance Use Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Substance Addiction Services) for over 23 years. HRiA launched the Vermont Helplink (Vermont Department of Health, Division of Substance Use Programs) in 2019. HRiA began operating the MA Problem Gambling Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Office of Problem Gambling Services) in 2020 and the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) in 2022. In December 2023, HRiA launched the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline, now the Oregon Hopeline (Oregon Health Authority).

The Helpline contact center is the hub for the Helplines. Screening & Information Specialists (SIS) comprise most of the contact center team and respond to incoming Helpline inquiries. Four Contact Center Supervisors provide Helpline services and provide direct supervision to a portion of the SIS team. Three Masters-level Clinicians supervise a portion of the SIS, implement follow-up services, and provide additional coverage and support. Additional Helpline team members deliver and support program operations, marketing and communication, web management, and data analysis and management, supervision, and leadership. The larger team is overseen by the Managing Director, Behavioral Health.

To learn more about HRiA and our helplines, visit the following:

  • HRiA:
  • IL Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • MA Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • IL Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances:
  • VT Helplink: www.VTHelplink.org
  • MA Substance Use Helpline:
  • Oregon Hopeline:

Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team on the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline (Oregon Hopeline), Massachusetts Substance Use & Problem Gambling Helplines (MA Helpline), the Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (IL Helpline), the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline, and the Vermont Helplink (VT Helplink). This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly developed position to support substance use treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

Position Description

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team for the MA Helpines, the IL Helplines, and VT Helplink. We refer to these projects collectively as “the Helplines.” This is an exciting opportunity to support substance use treatment and problem gambling treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

The Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for handling incoming Helpline inquiries and providing supervisory support to the contact center team. A portion of their time is providing scheduled and as-needed Helpline coverage, in addition to our dedicated team of 22 Screening & Information Specialists (SIS). This includes responding to incoming calls, online chats, and SMS text messages from people seeking information about and help with accessing substance use and/or problem gambling services for themselves, a family member or friend, and/or a client. In this capacity, they assess Helpline users’ needs, determine the most appropriate substance use prevention, treatment, and/or recovery support service options, identify available options (through the Helplines’ databases), and refer callers to those services. They provide accurate information, education, support, and referrals in a non-judgmental, respectful, and culturally competent manner.

About half of their time, Contact Center Supervisors provide supervisory support to the SIS team. Each Supervisor acts as a shift supervisor for SIS while they are working. This includes monitoring SIS consumer interactions, consulting with SIS and intervening during difficult interactions, and addressing any urgent issues as well as supporting the social-emotional wellbeing of staff and fostering their skill-building and professional growth. The Contact Center Supervisor will provide on-going training to SIS through periodic in-service trainings on relevant topics and will assist in the onboarding of new SIS.

Each Supervisor also directly supervises up to six SIS team members. This includes providing bi-weekly supervision, processing timesheets, and assisting with schedule coordination. (SIS also receive regular, group-level supervision from one of our Clinicians.) Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for supporting contact center operations, including helping to coordinate a 24/7 coverage schedule, staffing, and technology needs. They are the liaisons between the contact center team and information technology (IT) support. The Contact Center Supervisor will also be called upon to contribute expertise to the development of policies, procedures, protocols, and curricula to support the Helplines, and may be engaged in providing this expertise to other HRiA teams and projects focused on substance use, problem gambling, and/or behavioral health equity.

This is a full-time, remote position with a salary range of $57,000 to $64,000 based on skills and experience. Supervisors will receive training to assess the needs of Helpline users, provide appropriate information and referrals to services, and engage with and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals. They will also receive training on Contact Center operations, supervision essentials, and addiction, screening, treatment services, and resources.

Benefits

HRiA offers strong benefits to its employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Health insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Flexible summer hours
  • Vacation starting at four weeks
  • 13 paid holidays, and office closure at the end of December

Duties and Responsibilities

Management

  • Coordinate and implement projects related to contact center operations, including technology, equipment, onboarding & training, among others, as assigned.
  • Work with Helpline Management to coordinate Helpline staffing schedules to ensure continuous 24-hour staffing coverage.
  • Serve as liaison between SIS and other project and organizational teams, to ensure appropriate representation and facilitate team integration.
  • Supervise up to six SIS.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.

Project Work

  • Troubleshoot technical contact center issues, and serve as liaison to IT support.
  • Assist with coordination and implementation of onboarding and professional development activities.
  • Assess the needs of Helpline users by telephone, online chat, and SMS texting.
  • Provide appropriate information and referrals to substance use, problem gambling, and/or related services.
  • Engage and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals by using active listening and motivational interviewing techniques.
  • Obtain feedback on interactions with Helpline users.
  • Gather and record data from Helpline users in Helpline database.
  • Verify Helpline users’ insurance status, as applicable.
  • Escalate Helpline user interactions to Helpline Managers as needed.
  • Represent the Helpline at outreach events, meetings, and/or presentations as needed.

Thought Leadership

  • Continue to build and develop expertise in substance use disorders, problem gambling, and behavioral health equity.
  • Suggest ideas/improvements through participation in teams and committees.
  • Attend and actively participate in Helpline meetings and other activities to develop skills and make suggestions for project enhancements.

New Business Development

  • Maintain updated resume and bio for use in new business proposals.
  • Assist with technical components of new business proposals as needed.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Five years of related experience (lived or professional) in the fields of substance use, recovery, problem gambling, and/or harm reductions Services, and manage mentor bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, human services, or related field in lieu of experience.
  • Certified Resource Specialist (through Inform USA) preferred or willingness to obtain certification (at HRiA expense) within one year of hire.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to supervise staff, and provide appropriate guidance, feedback, mentorship, and support.
  • Experience in information and referral services, customer service, counseling, substance use, problem gambling, or human services required.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in work environment and expectations.
  • Customer/consumer focused with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Good computer skills and experience and/or ability to use online systems and databases.
  • Openness to information that may be different from personal views.
  • Willingness to work with consumers who may be ambivalent, resistant, impaired or have psychological disorders.
  • Must be open to providing information about a variety of treatment options and paths to recovery based on a caller’s needs.
  • Must be respectful of cultural differences and value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives.
  • Must have high ethical standards and a willingness to comply with professional expectations.
  • Demonstrated history of dependability needed.
  • Two years of sobriety requested for people in recovery.
  • Fluency in a language other than English (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin) is a plus.

Hours for this position will be non-traditional, requiring either early morning or late evening and weekend availability. The position includes weekend or overnight on-call duties. The Helplines are open 24 hours/day, 7 days/week, 365 days a year.

This description is intended to indicate the kinds of work duties that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under his/her supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty.

Procedure for Candidacy

HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Diversity is a core value of HRiA resulting in culturally competent services, materials, resources, and programs. Our hiring and business practices appreciate the strengths offered through different backgrounds.

HRiA is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

To apply, submit your cover letter and resume online at

Generally, our interviews take place between 9am-5pm ET. If you are contacted for an interview, please let us know if this timeframe is a challenge, so we can work with the interview team to find alternatives.

Senior macOS Software Engineer (Swift/SwiftUI)

Remote

Join the team behind Parallels Desktop, one of the world’s leading applications for Mac users.

We’re looking for a Senior macOS Software Engineer to help build and evolve the native user experience of Parallels Desktop. You’ll work with Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit, and modern macOS technologies to deliver features used by millions of customers worldwide.

This role combines new feature development, architecture improvements, and modernization of an established codebase. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to create exceptional user experiences while helping shape the future of one of the most recognized productivity applications on macOS.

If you’re passionate about building high-quality Mac applications and enjoy solving complex technical challenges at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Why Join Parallels?

Work on a product used by millions

Parallels Desktop is trusted by millions of users around the world to seamlessly run Windows applications on macOS. Your work will directly impact a large and engaged customer base.

Shape the future of a mature platform

You’ll help modernize and evolve a sophisticated macOS application, balancing new SwiftUI development with thoughtful improvements to an established codebase.

Remote-first culture

We believe great work can happen anywhere. Whether you work from a home office, a coworking space, or your favorite coffee shop, we provide the flexibility and autonomy to do your best work.

Work with exceptional people

Join a collaborative team of experienced engineers, designers, and product leaders who care deeply about craftsmanship, innovation, and delivering great customer experiences.

What You’ll Do

  • Build high-quality native macOS experiences using Swift and SwiftUI
  • Design, develop, and ship new features for Parallels Desktop
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, QA, and fellow engineers
  • Translate product requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions
  • Improve and modernize existing functionality through thoughtful refactoring
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues impacting product quality and customer experience
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical decision-making
  • Review code, mentor teammates, and help raise engineering standards across the team
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, tooling, and code quality

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Swift
  • Experience building and shipping native macOS applications
  • Strong knowledge of SwiftUI and AppKit
  • Familiarity with Cocoa, Foundation, and Combine frameworks
  • Experience with Swift concurrency (async/await, structured concurrency)
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to design maintainable, scalable software architectures
  • Experience delivering production-quality features throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Good understanding of Objective-C and interoperability with modern Swift code
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Self-driven mindset with strong ownership and accountability
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with C++ or Objective-C++
  • Experience with Swift ↔ C++ interoperability
  • Experience building client-server or distributed applications
  • Experience developing automated tests and improving test coverage
  • Familiarity with Git, Jira, and Confluence
  • Experience working on large-scale commercial desktop applications
  • Experience modernizing legacy codebases

About Parallels

Parallels is a leader in virtualization and end-user computing solutions, helping individuals and organizations work seamlessly across Windows, macOS, Linux, mobile devices, and the cloud.

For more than two decades, Parallels has delivered innovative solutions that combine performance, security, and simplicity, enabling users to access the technology they need anytime, anywhere, on any device.

Today, millions of customers worldwide rely on Parallels products to power productivity in both personal and professional environments.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Flexible working hours
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Opportunity to work on a globally recognized product
  • Collaborative and supportive engineering culture
  • Professional growth and development opportunities
  • Work-life balance that respects your time and priorities

Parallels is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you’re excited about building world-class macOS applications and making an impact on a product used by millions, we’d love to hear from you.

Who we are:

ManhattanLife Insurance and Annuity Company was founded in 1850, the Company’s longevity makes it one of the oldest and most reliable health and life insurance companies in the country. Operating successfully for over 175 years is a testimony to ManhattanLife’s enduring history, and an indicator of the reliability of our future. ManhattanLife’s headquarters are in Houston, TX and the company is continually growing with multiple office locations nation-wide. ManhattanLife offers attractive employee benefits starting day one, including immediate coverage under our health, dental and vision plans. We offer flexible schedules, including shortened hours on Fridays, free parking, company-wide events, professional development (LOMA testing) and a company-wide wellness program.

Scope and Purpose:

We are seeking an Account Implementation Manager 1. The Account Implementation Manager 1 (AIM 1) works as part of the Account Services team. Responsible for implementing new Voluntary Benefits groups, re-enrollment activities for existing groups and ongoing servicing activities involving enrollment, billing and claims activity. Acts as liaison between Sales/Marketing team and operations teams for audits and updates involving multiple departments

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the end-to-end management of the implementation process and key deliverables for new employer groups.
  • Collaborate, coordinate, and communicate with operational departments regarding implementation and build changes/updates for assigned book of business.
  • Perform audits and lead operational teams in updates required to resolve discrepancies.
  • Complete special projects and tasks as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree preferred with experience in account implementation and/or account servicing. Insurance experience and advanced Excel skills in pivot table and vLookup beneficial but not required.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills needed to manage and work with many different personalities and styles.
  • Ability to interact professionally and confidently with clients across a variety of communication methods such as WebEx, email, phone, or face-to-face meetings.
  • Must be able to multi-task with implementations at various stages and set priorities accordingly.
  • Independent decision-making, organizational, planning and problem-solving.

Travel Requirements:

This position may require some travel on occasion when in-person meetings with brokers or employer groups are needed.

Professional Development:

  • Establish annual objectives for professional growth.

JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Development Communications leads the development of strategic, donor-centered communications that advance the mission and philanthropic priorities of One More Child. This role translates organizational priorities, program impact, and funding opportunities into compelling proposals, stewardship communications, appeals, and other cases for support. Through exceptional writing, creative thinking, strategic collaboration, and effective project management, the Director develops high-quality communications, strengthens proposal resources and processes, and ensures philanthropic messaging is accurate, consistent, compelling, and aligned with One More Child’s mission, voice, and strategic vision.

Keystone is one of the largest and fastest-growing insurance brokerages in the country — ranked #26 among U.S. retail brokers and #4 fastest-growing in the Top 50 by Business Insurance. Through operational support in finance, HR, marketing, technology, producer development, and M&A, we empower agencies to grow while preserving what makes them who they are — their client relationships and their role in the communities they serve. Guided by our trademarked commitment, "Trust, our most important policy," Keystone is building the insurance solution every family and business can count on. For more information, visit .

Employee Benefits Producer

Position Summary:

The primary function of this role is to drive new business growth and maintain a profitable book of group employee benefits insurance accounts. This role is responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building long-term client relationships, and delivering customized insurance and risk management solutions. The ideal candidate is a consultative sales professional with a passion for helping businesses protect their assets and achieve their goals through strategic insurance planning.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Sales

  • Prospect and cultivate new group benefits insurance opportunities through networking, referrals, cold outreach, community involvement, and industry events.
  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans in partnership with Sales Leadership to achieve individual and agency growth objectives.
  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments to understand client exposures and recommend tailored insurance solutions.
  • Prepare and present professional insurance proposals that clearly communicate coverage options, value, and competitive advantages.
  • Maintain an active and organized sales pipeline within the CRM, ensuring timely follow-up and accurate forecasting.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team on targeted prospecting campaigns and lead generation initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell additional insurance products and coordinate referrals across business lines.

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for group benefits clients throughout the sales process and beyond.
  • Develop long-term relationships by delivering exceptional service, proactive communication, and ongoing risk management guidance.
  • Conduct regular policy reviews to ensure coverage remains aligned with clients' evolving business needs while identifying opportunities for additional products and services.
  • Partner closely with Account Managers to ensure a seamless client experience, promote retention, and support account growth.

Market and Industry Knowledge

  • Stay informed on group benefits insurance products, carrier appetites, underwriting guidelines, market trends, and regulatory developments.
  • Build and maintain productive relationships with insurance carriers and underwriters to negotiate competitive coverage and pricing.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities, industry conferences, networking events, and continuing education programs.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely documentation of sales activities, client interactions, and account information within the agency management system (Applied Epic) and CRM.
  • Ensure all new business submissions, renewals, endorsements, and policy documentation comply with agency standards, carrier requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Coordinate with internal service teams to ensure a smooth transition from new business to ongoing account management.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, or a related field preferred
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in business development, consultative sales, or a client-facing role
  • Demonstrated success in prospecting, relationship building, and consultative selling
  • Proven ability to meet or exceed sales goals in a competitive environment
  • Ability to obtain a Life & Health Insurance License upon hire; obtaining a Property & Casualty license is encouraged
  • Knowledge of group employee benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, voluntary benefits, and ancillary coverages a plus
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
  • Familiarity with Applied Epic, or comparable agency management system, and CRM systems preferred
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to establish credibility and build lasting client relationships
  • Highly organized with excellent time management and follow-through
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments
  • Willingness to travel for client meetings, networking events, and professional development opportunities
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check, as permitted by law

Description & requirements

Description

At Transcom, we are a global customer experience specialist with over 35 000 employees across the globe. We have already successfully deployed cutting-edge CX products, including AI Agents, Voice automations and real-time translation solutions that transform how millions of people experience customer service every day.


Now we are turning that same firepower inwards. We are looking for someone to make 35 000 colleagues measurably better at their jobs by giving each of them access to the right AI support toolset.


Join Transcom as a Workplace AI Enablement Lead


You are not starting from a blank page. Google's AI suite is Transcom's standard and is already deployed across the business, our security, privacy and compliance colleagues have already done the hard work of clearing the way. Pockets of the organisation are already running on this: early adopters who built their own notebooks, teams who rewired how they handle documentation, people who will happily show you a workflow they invented themselves.


What we need now is someone to take that momentum and make it the norm. The proof of concept phase is behind us. This is now about scale and a broader adoption across the company.


You will be the person who sits down with the HR team, a workforce planner or a country manager and shows them the one workflow that gives them back three hours a week, and then builds the network that spreads it without you in the room.


Your audience is deliberately not IT and not developers. It is everyone else. Your success is measured in habits changed, not features demoed.

This role is open to candidates inCroatia ideallybut we will consider candidates based in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Egypt, Latvia, Lithuania, Macedonia, Serbia, Slovenia, Spain or Tunisia.


You will


  • Own adoption:Take e.g. Gemini Enterprise and Google NotebookLM from "used well by some" to "indispensable to most", and be accountable for a measurable, visible spike in real daily and weekly usage across the business

  • Build the champion network:Our early adopters already exist and are already sharing — informally, generously and without much structure. You will find them, formalise the network, train them and give them the backing of a proper mandate, so they can sell the tools inside their own teams far better than any central function ever could. Adoption cannot be forced top-down — you will make it grow sideways

  • Create virtual teammates:Some teams have already built their own AI assistants and are seeing the benefit. You will make that repeatable — teaching leaders and contributors to configure specialised notebooks, reusable templates and custom instructions for the routine documentation, analysis and onboarding work that eats their week

  • Cut through the noise:Workspace AI ships new features constantly. You will vet them ruthlessly, ignore what is merely clever, and translate what is genuinely useful into plain, non-technical business language

  • Hold the line on safety:You are not inventing our guardrails from scratch — our security, privacy and ethical AI principles are established, and the specialists behind them are engaged and ready to support you. Your job is to make those boundaries land in everyday practice, so people know exactly what they can put into a prompt, and why they still have to check the answer

  • Prove it: Gather the field intelligence from your champions, build on the success stories we already have, and give leadership short, honest updates with the adoption metrics behind them


What's in it for YOU

  • A genuinely rare mandate: a global company that has already made the AI investment and is now serious about the most important part – getting people to actually drive value out of it

  • Visibility. This role touches every function and every geography.

  • The freedom to shape your own approach and actively influence how ways of working evolve across the organization

  • International and inclusive environment, that makes you feel supported, encouraged and welcome from day one

  • A personalized development plan and a dedicated education budget

  • Flexible work schedule and life-work balance


To be successful in this role, the following is needed:

  • A practitioner, not a commentator:real hands-on experience with Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Advanced and NotebookLM, or close equivalents such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise or Claude – you use these tools daily, not occasionally

  • Deep working knowledge of a collaboration suite (Google Workspace strongly preferred: Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet)

  • A translator:a proven ability to explain complex AI capability in simple, non-technical language to people who did not ask for a tech lesson

  • A pragmatist: instinctive bias towards workflows that save time over features that impress engineers

  • An influencer without authority: high credibility among peers, and a track record of inspiring, coaching and building networks of advocates without a reporting line to lean on

  • Confidence facilitating live sessions – demos, lunch-and-learns, open Q&A – and the ability to hold a room, including a sceptical one

  • A solid understanding of and genuine respect for enterprise compliance, security and data privacy principles

  • Experience in digital adoption, enablement, product or platform ownership, or a technical/analytical role in a large distributed organisation

  • A degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, Communication or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • English verbal and written is required (C1 or higher level)

  • Well-developed communication skills, a team player mentality and a willingness to share ideas and best practice



If you are tired of watching great AI tools go unused, and you would rather change how a global company works than write another strategy deck about it, let's talk.

Apply now with a full CV in English.

Closing date for applications is Wednesday 30th September 2026.

What Life at Transcom is like

At Transcom, we're relentlessly committed. To our clients and each other. Every day, someone starts their journey with Transcom. Taking the potential they have today and turning it into skills for the future. Getting recognized for working hard, being a team player, and supporting others. Championing positive, lasting change in their teams and communities. That's just how we are at Transcom. Here we care and root for each other. You're included, just as you are, from day one. And with the right mindset, there's no end to how far we can go together.

PHILANTHROPY OFFICER

Department: Development

PLEASE NOTE: This position is open to clients Texas or Ohio.

JOB SUMMARY

The Philanthropy Officer builds and strengthens meaningful, long-term relationships with donors and prospects who have the capacity and affinity to make significant philanthropic investments in One More Child. Reporting to the Senior Director of Philanthropy, this role engages and grows an assigned portfolio within a specific region, engaging donors through discovery, meaningful engagement, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship. The Philanthropy Officer develops individualized engagement strategies, builds a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects, and secures annual, capital, endowment, Comprehensive Campaign, and other strategic commitments in alignment with donor interests and One More Child’s priorities. Working collaboratively with the Executive Director of Philanthropy, Chief Advancement Officer and other organizational leaders, the Philanthropy Officer serves as a trusted ambassador for One More Child and invites donors into meaningful participation in the organization’s mission.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS

Donor Relationships & Portfolio Management

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of donors, building authentic, long-term relationships through meaningful engagement, discovery, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Develop individualized relationship strategies based on each donor’s interests, passions, capacity, giving history, and relationship with One More Child.
  • Maintain consistent, thoughtful contact with donors through personal visits, calls, meetings, stewardship touchpoints, ministry experiences, events, and other meaningful engagement opportunities.
  • Listen to and understand donor interests and motivations, connecting them with opportunities to meaningfully advance the mission of One More Child.
  • Create meaningful donor experiences in partnership with regional, campus, program, and organizational leaders that deepen understanding of One More Child’s mission and impact.
  • Personally solicit and steward 5- and 6-figure gifts, multi-year commitments, and other philanthropic investments in collaboration with the Executive Director of Philanthropy and organizational leaders.

Prospect & Pipeline Development

  • Identify, engage in discovery, and cultivate prospective donors with the capacity and affinity to make significant investments in One More Child.
  • Build and maintain a healthy portfolio and pipeline, advancing qualified prospects through intentional relationship strategies and appropriate next steps.
  • Participate in regular portfolio and pipeline reviews with the Executive Director of Philanthropy and the Director of Development Strategy, using relationship intelligence to prioritize opportunities and strengthen donor investment.
  • Partner with the Director of Development Strategy to effectively use CRM data, metrics, analytics, and pipeline reporting to inform portfolio management and fundraising strategies.

Strategic & Campaign Fundraising

  • Develop and execute donor strategies that align donor interests and passions with One More Child’s strategic priorities and funding opportunities.
  • Participate in the Comprehensive Campaign and other strategic fundraising initiatives, cultivating and soliciting individual commitments for capital, endowment, annual giving, and other organizational priorities.
  • Collaborate with the Executive Director of Philanthropy, Chief Advancement Officer, Senior Vice President of Strategic Development, and other organizational leaders on significant donor strategies and solicitations.

Donor Communications & Collaboration

  • Provide donor insight and strategic direction for proposals, presentations, stewardship communications, and other materials supporting cultivation and solicitation.
  • Partner with the Director of Development Communications to develop compelling, donor-centered proposals and communications that connect donor interests with meaningful philanthropic opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Advancement, Communications, Programs, Partnerships, regional, and campus teams to ensure a coordinated and compelling donor experience.
  • Serve as an ambassador for One More Child, clearly and authentically communicating its mission, impact, vision, and opportunities for philanthropic partnership through events, personal visits, and speaking opportunities.

Performance & Professional Development

  • Meet established fundraising, portfolio, meaningful engagement, and pipeline goals while maintaining a focus on long-term donor relationships and sustainable philanthropic growth.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of donor interactions, strategies, next steps, and portfolio activity in the organization’s CRM.
  • Continuously develop knowledge of One More Child’s programs, impact, strategic priorities, and funding opportunities to effectively engage and inspire donors.
  • Demonstrate integrity, discretion, professionalism, initiative, sound judgment, and commitment to ethical, relationship-based philanthropy.
  • Stay current with best practices in philanthropy and continually strengthen skills in donor engagement, discovery, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Travel within assigned region regularly; at least annual visit to Headquarters in Lakeland.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Professional & Organizational Expectations

  • Pursues ongoing personal and professional growth to strengthen expertise and effectiveness in writing, proposal development, project management, and related areas through seminars, webinars, workshops, books, software, professional publications, and professional affiliations.
  • Brings creativity, initiative, strong organizational skills, and a high level of motivation to the role.
  • Demonstrates integrity, sound judgment, and maturity consistent with the organization’s core beliefs and values.
  • Demonstrates a positive attitude and genuine passion for the organization’s mission of providing Christ-centered services to children and families in need.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • N/A


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in nonprofit management, business, communications, marketing, public relations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in philanthropy, fundraising, development, sales, relationship management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain authentic, trust-based relationships with individuals and organizations.
  • Experience cultivating relationships and securing financial support, investments, or other commitments from donors, customers, clients, or partners.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to listen effectively, ask thoughtful questions, understand motivations, and communicate compellingly with diverse audiences.
  • Ability to develop and execute individualized relationship strategies and manage multiple relationships, priorities, and opportunities with strong organization and follow-through.
  • Demonstrated initiative, sound judgment, professionalism, integrity, and discretion in working with individuals and confidential information.

About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission

As part of the Engine team, you'll play a vital role in an environment where innovation meets collaboration. Here's what you'll take charge of:

  • Own Product-Led Growth: Craft and execute experimentation-driven strategies across onboarding, activation, retention loops, and monetization. You'll move the metrics that matter most: activation rate, time to value, product-qualified leads, net dollar retention, and expansion revenue.
  • Build AI-Powered Experiences: Collaborate with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market partners to apply LLMs, predictive logic, and smart automation that reduce friction, personalize the journey, and get customers to value faster.
  • Grow Every Account: Drive cross-sell and attach across hotels, flights, cars, and groups, and adoption of Direct Bill, FlexPro, and Rewards at the moment of need. Keep accounts booking through quiet stretches and team changes.
  • Connect Product and Sales: Spot high-intent moments in the product and get those accounts to the right sales or account team fast, so self-serve and human help work as one motion.
  • Lead Experimentation at Scale: Form hypotheses, design and run A/B tests, and partner with data teams to turn results into action. Test early, learn fast, and scale what works across Engine's travel and spend management platform.
  • Align and Influence: Translate complex ideas into clear, compelling plans, rally cross-functional stakeholders around shared goals, and make sure every growth feature delivers a seamless, high-impact experience for Engine customers.

What You'll Bring to Engine

We're looking for someone who's ready to make an impact and grow alongside us:

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on product management experience, ideally for a self-serve or product-led B2B product. You’ve owned a conversion or revenue metric and moved metrics in at least two of acquisition, activation, expansion, and retention.
  • Skills: You're a problem-solver with strong analytical and experimentation skills. You're comfortable designing tests, interpreting results, and turning data into decisions, and you thrive in fast-paced, innovative environments.
  • Tech-Savvy: You understand how to apply AI to prototype, ship small fixes, and interrogate data. You're fluent in experimentation/analytics tools, e.g. Amplitude, LaunchDarkly, SQL.
  • Mindset: You're deeply curious, outcome-focused, and ready to roll up your sleeves, collaborate, and deliver results that matter.
  • Influence: You translate complex ideas into clear, compelling plans and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, sales, account management, and marketing.

Applications for this role will be accepted through 02/08/2027 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$181,100—$213,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

Parallels has an immediate vacancy for this role.

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

We’re looking for an experienced Principal Backend Engineer to help us change the way the world works, withParallels:anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity. Here, you’ll drive the outbound prospecting effort by executing strategic prospecting campaigns to target accounts and executive personas with our Parallels team.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  2. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
  3. It’s your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let’s talk more about thePrincipal Backend Engineer roleand see if we’re destined to be together.

Requirements

  • Expert knowledge of modern backend infrastructureand asynchronous messaging/storage (RabbitMQ, Celery, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, etc.).
  • Solid foundation in Python (or deep expertise in Go/C++/Rust with a working knowledge of Python)coupled with the engineering maturity to quickly master the Python backend ecosystem.
  • Extensive Backend Experiencewith a proven track record in principal-level roles designing complex, distributed systems.
  • Pragmatic Architectural Mastery.Expertise in designing highly cohesive, loosely coupled systems. Deep understanding of software design patterns and architectural methodologies such as Domain-Driven Design, Clean Architecture, Hexagonal combined with the clear judgment on when simpler approaches are better.
  • Strong background in designing client APIs.Not just individual APIs or groups, but the entire API schema and contract of a system.
  • Deep understanding of cloud architecture, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices, drive technical consensus, andlead complex architectural transitions across multiple teams.
  • You have skills and authority to coach and mentor the team. You have skills or knowledge the team can learn from you.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Azure as a cloud platform.
  • Experience designing and implementing GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other container orchestration tools.
  • Experience implementing Identity Management in enterprise applications (SCIM provisioning, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML).
  • Polyglot background:Experience with Golang, Rust, or C++ for performance-critical domains.
  • Spec-Driven Development (SDD) & AI-Native Engineering.Experience designing formal, machine-readable specifications and strict contracts, tests as the single source of truth. You know how to define strict system boundaries and executable contracts that constrain AI agents, ensuring they accelerate code generation without introducing architectural drift or spaghetti code.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive and define architectural roadmaps for backend systems.
  • Architect and lead the strategic decomposition of a mature Django application into scalable, asynchronous microservices.
  • Define technical strategy, tech stack, and how code is organized across repositories.Make critical build-vs-buy decisions, including evaluating whether to proceed with internal implementation vs. using a 3rd-party tool.
  • Write code for the most complex, critical system mechanisms.While you won't be fixing everyday bugs, you will implement the most critical mechanisms, and features for the business. Help teammates when needed.
  • Architect secure and scalable integration patternsacross the system, establishing best practices for 3rd-party integrations, identity management, and SSO/SCIM integrations.
  • Redefine system architecture & designby auditing existing microservices and implementing strict bounded contexts.
  • Design robust, scalable, and standardized APIs. Take ownership of the cloud architecture strategy with a strong emphasis on backend resilience, fault tolerance, and performance.
  • Act as the technical cornerstone for the engineering team.Partner directly with engineering leadership to define and enforce technical standards. You will have the organizational backing to drive complex architectural transitions across a team of 7-8 engineers.

About Parallels

Parallels is a top VDI/EUC product helping businesses since 1999. Whether it's desktop or cloud, on-prem or hybrid, Parallels delivers speed, security, and affordability for the modern work environment.

Success, Simplified.

At Ironmark, we make marketing easier.

We bring digital and physical marketing together in one place, helping our customers spend less time managing vendors and more time growing their businesses. From print and promotional products to digital marketing, technology, logistics, and fulfillment, we connect the pieces so marketers can move faster, work smarter, and get better results.

Our customers count on us to simplify complex marketing challenges and help their brands show up consistently across channels, locations, and communities. We care about their success, operate with integrity, solve for the customer, and win as one team.

Job Summary

As a key leader at Ironmark, the Head of Automotive will oversee a team of Account Executives— focused on acquiring new Tier 3 automotive dealers (rooftops).

The ideal candidate is a strategic player/coach with deep experience selling into Tier 3 Automotive (Fixed Operations), and a strong history of building high-performing teams and exceeding revenue goals. Success in this role will be measured by new logo acquisition, client retention, and consistent year-over-year automotive revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, scale, and lead a high-performing automotive sales team through effective recruitment, onboarding, training, and coaching.
  • Operate as a true player/coach—setting vision, modeling excellence, and actively participating in key sales pursuits and client engagements.
  • Provide ongoing mentorship to ensure consistent execution, professional development, and accountability across all prospecting, sales, and client-facing activities.
  • Lead by example. Develop and manage a personal book of business while monitoring team performance using tools such as Gong and HubSpot to maintain activity expectations, achieve sales targets, and support broader business objectives.Particularlyin the early years before the sales team has beenfully developed, it will be important to“pound the pavement” to acquire new dealership clients.
  • Join critical client and prospect calls, review engagement data, and deliver targeted, actionable feedback to drive continuous improvement and adherence to best practices.

Strategic Planning and Forecasting

  • Partner with Ironmark’s executive team to define target accounts, set revenue goals, identify growth opportunities, and align strategic priorities.
  • Own full-funnel forecasting and provide regular updates on pipeline health, account performance, emerging risks, and expansion opportunities.
  • Plan and justify budget and headcount to support the continued growth and scalability of the automotive business.

Drive New Business Growth – Acquire New Customers, Grow Existing Customer Revenue and Strengthen Client Retention

  • Lead Ironmark’s automotive revenue expansion by operationalizing Ironmark’s proven new-business approach—personally opening doors while coaching AEs to execute consistently and target new Tier 3 rooftops.
  • Equip the team with strong messaging and effective sales methodologies to drive consistent pipeline creation and high conversion rates.
  • Deliver measurable growth through new logo acquisition and deeper penetration of Ironmark’s automotive footprint.

Sales Process Excellence and Deal Management

  • Lead a consistent, high-quality sales process from prospecting through close, including LinkedIn and email engagement, targeted in person dealer outreach, discovery calls, software demonstrations, and proposal development.
  • Clearly articulate Ironmark’s value proposition and ensure continuous engagement across the full buying committee.
  • Uphold rigorous utilization of HubSpot for pipeline tracking, documentation, forecasting, and real-time visibility.
  • Maintain adherence to the sales playbook and ensure consistent execution across the team.

Contract Negotiation & Renewals

  • Lead contract negotiations, optimizing profitability while maintaining a strong client experience.
  • Ensure agreements align with both client needs and Ironmark’s financial objectives.

Internal Collaboration & Communication

  • Leverage internal SMEs to deliver compelling and high-impact solutions during the sales process.
  • Partner with internal subject matter experts to ensure timely and accurate delivery of contracted services.
  • Foster strong cross-functional communication to support client success and organizational alignment.

Client Advocacy & Feedback Loop

  • Serve as the voice of the customer within Ironmark—capturing insights, surfacing pain points, and recommending product and service enhancements to drive greater value and client satisfaction

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong leadership skills, with a history of building and managing high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive significant revenue growth and profitability.
  • Deep understanding of automotive market trends, the competitive landscape and evolving customer needs.
  • Experience successfully selling into automotive dealerships
  • Knowledge of integrated marketing - digital and physical
  • Skilled in selling SaaS and/or data solutions
  • Experience managing proposals and contracts.
  • Adept at strategic negotiation.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including integrity, professional etiquette, and relationship management skills.

Experience

  • 5+ years of demonstrated success selling into the Tier 3 automotive dealership space (Fixed Operations), with at least 2 years in a leadership role.
  • Proven track record of achieving year-over-year growth through new logo acquisition, cross-selling, and upselling.
  • Strong ability to lead, coach and develop Account Executives at varying stages of their careers.

Compensation

The base pay for this position is $140,000 -- 200,000, plus uncapped variable compensation.

WHAT DOES AN SVP, MEDICAL DO?

The role of a Senior Vice President (SVP), Medical at a pharmaceutical advertising agency involves a blend of strategic leadership, medical expertise, and client management. The SVP, Medical at EVERSANA INTOUCH is responsible for developing and implementing medical strategies that align with client goals and regulatory requirements. This role involves leading and mentoring a team of medical directors, writers, and other professionals, ensuring the scientific accuracy and integrity of all medical content. The SVP serves as the primary medical liaison for clients, providing expert advice and insights, and building strong relationships with key stakeholders. Key duties include overseeing the development of compliant medical content for promotional materials, staying updated on the latest medical research and regulatory changes, and providing guidance during the development of marketing strategies. The SVP also works closely with creative, account, and strategy teams to integrate medical insights into campaigns, presents medical strategies and results to clients, and fosters a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and excellence.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Develop and implement medical strategies that align with client goals and regulatory requirements.

  • Lead and mentor a team of medical directors, writers, and other medical professionals.

  • Ensure the scientific accuracy and integrity of all medical content produced by the agency.

  • Serve as the primary medical liaison for clients, providing expert advice and insights.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, healthcare professionals, and regulatory bodies.

  • Oversee the development of medical content for promotional materials, ensuring compliance with industry standards.

  • Stay updated on the latest medical research, treatments, and regulatory changes.

  • Provide medical and scientific guidance during the development of marketing strategies and campaigns.

  • Review and approve all medical content to ensure it meets high standards of quality and accuracy.

  • Work closely with creative, account, and strategy teams to integrate medical insights into campaigns.

  • Present medical strategies and campaign results to clients and internal teams.

  • Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and excellence.

  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

  • All other duties as assigned

PEOPLE LEADER

People leaders must possess both the skills to effectively accomplish these tasks and the emotional intelligence to do so in alignment with our cultural values. In addition to the critical management and leadership tasks listed above, this role also includes the following unique responsibilities:

  • Responsible for and oversee their respective department.

  • Interview, select and supervise the activities of the department staff; communicate interpret and discuss with team the company policies and procedures.

  • Determine job objectives, work methods and performance standards; review performance relative to departmental objectives discussion appraisal with each employee and performance; authorize and communicate salary changes, promotions, transfers, discipline, and discharge and administer all other personnel actions.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD or MD with 10+ years of experience in an agency or pharmaceutical industry supporting scientific communications, medical affairs or medical education. 

  • Extensive experience in medical affairs, medical communications, or a related field, preferably within a pharmaceutical or healthcare advertising agency.

  • Strong leadership and management skills, excellent communication and presentation abilities, and a deep understanding of medical and regulatory environments.

  • This role is crucial for ensuring that the agency's medical communications are both scientifically accurate and strategically effective

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). This role is eligible for hire in select U.S. locations based on business and operational considerations. For a full list of locations, visit eversana.com/careers. More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at .

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs.

raw.description:
(Remote first, with occasional travel to London)

The People & Culture Partner plays a key role in enabling our managers and leaders to create an environment where our people can do their best work.
Partnering with business leaders across your allocated business areas, you'll provide pragmatic, commercially focused people advice across the full employee lifecycle. You'll build trusted relationships with managers, helping them navigate employee relations matters, organisational change, workforce planning and performance, whilst ensuring an exceptional employee experience.
This is a varied, fast-paced role requiring someone who is comfortable working in ambiguity, balancing operational priorities with longer-term people initiatives, and providing practical solutions to complex people challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Culture and Communications

  • Promote and embed our cultural values throughout all activities.
  • Arrange and attend internal events, communications and training to evangelise our core values and desired culture, keeping them at the forefront of our people’s minds.
  • Identify and implement improvements for diversity and inclusion, health and happiness, work environment, recognition and communication.
  • Challenge behaviours which are not consistent with our people strategy and culture.

Performance Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Identify improvements for departments and individuals by analysing data and other inputs.
  • Assist our leaders in succession planning to solve single points of failure and to plan internal promotions.
  • Provide comprehensive, pragmatic and commercially focused employment advice and best practice guidance to managers, ensuring they are equipped to confidently manage their teams.
  • Coach managers and our people to improve performance and conduct, implementing formal action where required.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on employee relations matters, including disciplinary, grievance, capability, absence management and performance cases.
  • Support organisational change initiatives, restructures and TUPE consultations where required.
  • Support managers in ensuring our people have clear and measurable objectives and development plans.
  • Resolve employee questions, enquiries and complaints, or direct them to the appropriate parties.
  • Support the implementation of People policies and procedures, ensuring fairness, consistency and compliance with employment legislation.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Finance to provide guidance on contractor engagements, including contractor compliance, IR35 considerations and contingent workforce requirements.
  • Support the delivery of the People Agenda by working alongside the Head of People and Culture to execute objectives that support the wider priorities of the People Function.
  • Promote fairness, consistency and an excellent employee experience at every opportunity.

Personal Development

  • Coach and advise managers to set meaningful development objectives for their teams and individuals.
  • Implement training sessions and development programmes that inspire our people to do their best work.
  • Create and deliver engaging learning resources that build management capability and support organisational development.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or substantial equivalent experience.
  • Experience in an operational/generalist HR role, typically of at least five years.
  • Strong employee relations experience, with the confidence and credibility to manage complex cases independently.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of UK employment law.
  • Demonstrable experience of implementing policies, procedures and organisational change.
  • Experience supporting organisational restructures, consultations and TUPE transfers.
  • Experience supporting contractor populations and an understanding of contractor compliance and IR35 requirements.
  • Experience of delivering training sessions and creating learning resources.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge constructively at all levels.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make pragmatic, balanced decisions.
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Enthusiastic, motivated self-starter.
  • Service-driven, with a genuine passion for delivering an excellent experience for managers and employees.
  • Pragmatic and solutions-focused, able to balance commercial needs with people considerations.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Confident reaching out to stakeholders and colleagues to solve problems and understand business needs.
  • Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
  • Resilient, approachable and able to build trust across all levels of the organisation.
  • Happy working in a remote-first environment with occasional travel.
