Job Description:

Mental Wellbeing Practitioner

Fully remote - UK only

Permanent. Full or part time (minimum of 3 days per week - 22.5 hours)

Working hours on a rota basis between 8am - 10pm, including weekends

Salary: £28,750* per annum plus excellent Bupa benefits

*based on full-time, if part-time this will be pro-rata

This advert may close ahead of the stated deadline should we receive an exceptionally high number of applications.

We make health happen:

This is a fantastic opportunity to really make a difference to the wellbeing of a diverse range of clients and at the same time, an opportunity where you can continue in your own clinical career development.

You’ll help us make health happen by:

Conduct remote (telephone or video) mental health assessments and make evidence- based treatment recommendations for Bupa clients, customers and members, in line with NICE guidelines and in accordance with relevant policies and procedures. The role will involve working independently whilst under clinical supervision from Qualified professionals including Clinical Psychologists and Cognitive Behavioural Psychotherapists and as part of a clinical team whilst liaising daily with internal services and external organisations. There will be ongoing clinical guidance from Qualified mental health professionals, including regular clinical supervision, and there is an expectation that work will be within clinical competencies.

Key Skills / Qualifications needed for this role:

  • You hold an MSc in Psychology and have a minimum of 6 months' experience working within a mental health clinical environment.

  • Experience conducting assessments would be desirable.

OR

  • You hold an undergraduate degree in Psychology and have at least 1 years’ experience working within a mental health clinical environment.

  • Experience conducting assessments would be desirable.

• Strong professional and personal drive

• Empathic, compassionate and responsive

• Trauma-informed approach

• Enthusiastic and self-motivated
• Ability to respond rapidly and decisively
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• IT proficient
• Proven experience of customer service
• Working within level of competence and recognising when to seek supervision

Benefits:

Our benefits are designed to make health happen for our people. Viva is our global wellbeing programme and includes all aspects of our health – from mental and physical, to financial, social and environmental wellbeing. We support flexible working and have a range of family friendly benefits.

Joining Bupa in this role you will receive the following benefits and more:
• Equivalent to 25 days holiday per year, increasing through length of service, with option to buy or sell

• Enhanced pension and life insurance

• Support with travel costs via a season ticket loan or cycle2work
• Discounted access to online gym sessions
• Annual performance-based bonus
• Bupa health insurance as a benefit in kind
• Option to join dental insurance scheme at a discounted rate
• Access to our Digital GP platform on you mobile
• Emotional wellbeing support
• Access to family mental health line
• Financial wellbeing channels

• Support for carers

Why Bupa?

We’re a health insurer and provider. With no shareholders, our customers are our focus. Our people are all driven by the same purpose – helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. We make health happen by being brave, caring and responsible in everything we do.

We encourage all of our people to “Be you at Bupa”, we champion diversity, and we understand the importance of our people representing the communities and customers we serve. That’s why we especially encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

Bupa is a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. This means we aim to offer an interview/assessment to every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria for the role. We’ll make sure you are treated fairly and offer reasonable adjustments as part of our recruitment process to anyone that needs them.

Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK, as sponsorship is not available for this position.

Home Based North c/o Bupa Place, Nationwide

raw.title: Senior AI Software Developer
raw.excerpt: Over StaxxerStaxxer helpt e-commerce ondernemers hun financiële administratie en compliance te automatiseren.
raw.description:
Over Staxxer

Staxxer helpt e-commerce ondernemers hun financiële administratie en compliance te automatiseren. Van btw en OSS tot EPR en boekhouding. Wat begon als een dienstverlening voor online verkopers, groeit uit tot een softwareplatform dat e-commerce ondernemers steeds meer financieel werk uit handen neemt.

Daarvoor maken we een belangrijke transitie: van een servicegedreven organisatie naar een softwaregedreven bedrijf. We bouwen verder op onze bestaande producten, data en financiële expertise, met AI als belangrijke versneller.

Een van onze volgende stappen is bijvoorbeeld de ontwikkeling van een E-commerce CFO: een financiële co-pilot die ondernemers niet alleen vertelt hoe ze ervoor staan, maar ook helpt begrijpen waar ze geld verdienen, waar kansen liggen en wat ze kunnen verbeteren.

En daar hebben we jou voor nodig.

Over de rol

We zoeken een Senior AI Software Developer die de brug slaat tussen finance, software en AI.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze financiële experts, product owner en developers. Je ontdekt welke financiële vraagstukken onze klanten dagelijks tegenkomen en vertaalt die naar slimme, schaalbare software.

Je bent geen developer die alleen tickets afwerkt. Je bent een ervaren engineer die problemen begrijpt, technische oplossingen bedenkt en deze zelfstandig realiseert.

In het begin werk je dicht met onze eigen financiële experts. Je bouwt tools waarmee zij sneller en slimmer kunnen werken. Je experimenteert met klanten, valideert oplossingen en ontdekt wat écht waarde toevoegt.

Je krijgt daarin veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. We zoeken iemand die liever binnen een week een werkende oplossing laat zien dan maanden besteedt aan het schrijven van specificaties.

Wat ga je doen?

1. Financiële advies vertalen naar een AI gedreven software product.

Onze financiële experts helpen dagelijks e-commerce ondernemers met complexe financiële vraagstukken. Jij onderzoekt welke kennis, analyses en werkzaamheden we kunnen automatiseren.

  • Bouw financiële rapportages, analyses, exports en interne tools die gebruikt worden om de e-commerce klant te kunnen voorzien van financiële expertise.

  • Vertaal terugkerende klantvragen naar herbruikbare software.

  • Automatiseer handmatige financiële processen.

2. AI-native producten ontwikkelen

AI verandert fundamenteel hoe financiële software wordt gebouwd en gebruikt. Jij helpt ons die mogelijkheden concreet te maken.

  • Ontwikkel AI-functionaliteiten die ondernemers helpen hun financiële cijfers in te zien, te begrijpen en afwijkingen pro actief te signaleren.

  • Bouw verder op de bestaande AI-assistent binnen My Staxxer.

  • Breid onze MCP-integratie uit, zodat AI-assistenten veilig met financiële klantdata kunnen gaan werken.

  • Experimenteer met LLM’s, agents en bestaande AI-tooling.

  • Zorg dat AI-oplossingen betrouwbaar, controleerbaar en veilig zijn.

3. De E-commerce CFO vormgeven

We weten waar we naartoe willen, maar nog niet precies hoe het eindproduct eruitziet. Dat gaan we ontdekken door te bouwen.

  • Ontwikkel prototypes en MVP’s voor een “e-commerce CFO”, wat een agentic laag is boven onze grote e-commerce data set.

  • Test oplossingen met onze eigen experts en bestaande klanten.

  • Help bepalen welke functionaliteiten voldoende waarde leveren om voor te betalen.

  • Vertaal succesvolle experimenten naar schaalbare productfunctionaliteiten.

Je bouwt dus niet alleen software. Je denkt actief mee over wat we moeten bouwen, waarom en voor wie.

4. Slim bouwen op bestaande technologie

Staxxer heeft al een uitgebreid platform met modules voor btw, OSS, EPR, integraties en boekhouding.

Die bestaande infrastructuur biedt veel mogelijkheden, maar kent ook technische uitdagingen.

  • Ontsluit bestaande data via betrouwbare interfaces en API’s.

  • Bepaal welke data geschikt is voor financiële analyses en AI-toepassingen.

  • Maak pragmatische keuzes tussen hergebruik, refactoring en nieuwbouw.

  • Werk samen met ons development team aan een schaalbare architectuur.

  • Zorg dat nieuwe oplossingen aansluiten op ons bestaande platform.

Je begrijpt dat snelheid belangrijk is, maar dat betrouwbare financiële data niet onderhandelbaar is.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Bij Staxxer krijg je de vrijheid om te bouwen, te experimenteren en daadwerkelijk impact te maken. We bieden je veel verantwoordelijkheid, vertrouwen en de middelen om je werk goed te doen.

  • Een salaris van €5.500 tot €8.000 bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur en afhankelijk van je ervaring en expertise.

  • Onbeperkte vakantiedagen. We vertrouwen erop dat je zelf een gezonde balans vindt tussen werk en privé.

  • Remote werken. Werk waar je het beste presteert. We verwachten wel dat je aanwezig bent op belangrijke momenten, zoals onze company trips, teamdagen en kerstviering.

  • €100 per maand vrij besteedbaar pensioenbudget. Je bepaalt zelf hoe je dit inzet voor je pensioenopbouw.

  • Een MacBook van de zaak. Inclusief alle software en AI-tools die je nodig hebt.

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Budget en mogelijkheden voor opleidingen, conferenties en nieuwe technologieën.

  • Veel vrijheid en eigenaarschap. Je krijgt de ruimte om technische keuzes te maken en actief richting te geven aan een nieuwe productlijn.

  • Directe samenwerking met de oprichters. Korte lijnen met ons development team, onze financiële experts en het management.

  • Een ambitieus en gezellig team. Met company trips, teamactiviteiten en momenten om samen successen te vieren.

Waarom Staxxer?

Bij veel bedrijven werk je aan een klein onderdeel van een bestaand product. Bij Staxxer krijg je de kans om vanaf het begin mee te bouwen aan een compleet nieuwe productlijn.

Je hoeft niet vanaf nul te beginnen. We hebben bestaande klanten, financiële experts, een development team en een groeiende hoeveelheid relevante data.

Tegelijkertijd staat de ontwikkeling van onze financiële co-pilot nog aan het begin. Dat betekent veel ruimte om te experimenteren, keuzes te maken en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op het eindproduct.

We geloven in kleine teams, veel eigenaarschap en snel leren door dingen daadwerkelijk te bouwen.

Requirements

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken een ervaren, zelfstandige engineer die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van nieuwe producten. Iemand die niet alleen technisch sterk is, maar ook begrijpt hoe je technologie inzet om echte klantproblemen op te lossen.

Wat je meebrengt:

  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur binnen een fintech organisatie.

  • Sterke programmeervaardigheden, bijvoorbeeld in Python, TypeScript of PHP, en uitgebreide ervaring met SQL .

  • Ervaring met softwarearchitectuur en het ontwikkelen van betrouwbare, schaalbare applicaties.

  • Je werkt AI-native en gebruikt tools zoals Claude Code, Cursor of vergelijkbare oplossingen dagelijks om sneller en beter software te ontwikkelen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten, van eerste prototype tot productie.

  • Je begrijpt hoe je nieuwe software bouwt op een bestaande codebase met technical debt.

  • Je denkt vanuit de gebruiker, neemt eigenaarschap en weet technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete productwaarde.

  • Je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel developers als niet-technische collega’s.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

Mooi meegenomen:

  • Ervaring met financiële software, boekhouding of e-commerce.

  • Ervaring met LLM’s, MCP, AI-agents of RAG.

  • Kennis van financiële systemen zoals Exact Online.

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en valideren van nieuwe softwareproducten.

Een specifieke opleiding vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je daadwerkelijk kunt bouwen.

Solliciteren

We zijn benieuwd naar wat je kunt bouwen. Stuur ons je cv, een korte introductie en bij voorkeur iets wat je zelf hebt ontwikkeld. Dat mag een product, script, AI-experiment of sideproject zijn. We horen vooral graag welk probleem je hebt opgelost, hoe je dat hebt aangepakt en wat het resultaat was. Klinkt dit als jouw volgende uitdaging? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Contact:

Highlights

Bouw als engineer mee aan de financiële co-pilot voor e-commerce ondernemers.

Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States.

With a steadfast commitment to customer service, operational excellence, and superior network capabilities, Uniti builds, operates and delivers critical fiber-based communications services to connect and empower people and businesses.

About the Role:

This Counsel position provides legal support for the Company's regulatory compliance function. This attorney will work closely with the VP-Regulatory Counsel to support the Company's regulatory compliance obligations as a regulated utility, regulatory reporting requirements, investigations, policy development, and implementation standards. The position is intended to develop additional in-house regulatory expertise and serve as a key legal resource supporting federal and state regulatory compliance activities across the organization.

This role offers significant opportunities for professional growth, direct exposure to senior leadership, and hands-on experience supporting a broad range of legal, regulatory, and compliance matters across Uniti’s business units.

What You'll Do:

  • Assist with the interpretation and implementation of federal, state, and local regulatory requirements impacting the Company's telecommunications and broadband operations.
  • Support regulatory compliance programs and reporting obligations, including preparation and review of regulatory filings, certifications, disclosures, and responses to agency inquiries.
  • Monitor legal and regulatory developments and evaluate potential impacts to business operations.
  • Identify regulatory and compliance risks and assist business stakeholders in developing practical mitigation strategies.
  • Conduct legal research and prepare analyses, recommendations, and guidance regarding regulatory and compliance matters.
  • Assist with responses to regulatory investigations, audits, consumer complaints, and information requests.
  • Draft and review policies, procedures, customer communications, disclosures, training materials, and other compliance-related documents.
  • Manage and coordinate projects involving internal stakeholders, consultants, outside counsel, and regulatory agencies.
  • Collaborate with business owners across the company including network and field operations, engineering, sales, marketing, and customer care.

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school.
  • Licensed to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • 1-5 years of legal experience in a law firm, corporate legal department, government agency, judicial clerkship, or similar environment.
  • Strong legal research, writing, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience supporting audits, investigations, or compliance programs.

Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

Utilization Management Nurse (LPN/LVN), Level I

Ready to make sure every member gets the right care at the right time?

Why This Role Matters

Behind every prior authorization and inpatient stay is a member waiting on a decision, and you’re the one who makes sure that decision is timely, accurate, and grounded in evidence. As a Level I Utilization Management Nurse, you review requests for medical necessity, level of care, and benefit coverage, then apply clinical guidelines and plan policies to keep care appropriate and compliant. Your sharp review work protects members from delays and unnecessary services, supports providers who need clear answers, and keeps our programs ready for URAC and NCQA scrutiny. When your reviews are thorough, well-documented, and delivered on time, our whole organization earns the trust of the members and sponsors who rely on us.

What You’ll Actually Do

  • Perform clinical reviews that drive sound determinations: Evaluate requests for medical necessity, appropriate level of care, documentation completeness, and benefit coverage, so members get timely decisions that meet compliance standards.

  • Apply guidelines in the right hierarchy: Use internal medical policies, group-specific policies, NCCN, and MCG as applicable, and record your criteria and policy rationale in the UM system so every decision stands on solid ground.
  • Escalate the cases that need advanced eyes: Refer requests that fall outside guidelines, fail to meet criteria, or may require adverse determination to senior staff or the Medical Director, and support IRO referrals in line with policy and jurisdictional requirements.
  • Verify benefits and guide members in-network: Review plan documents to support benefit determinations, and redirect providers and members to PPO or in-network options when it fits plan requirements.
  • Build audit-ready case summaries: Prepare clear, complete documentation for Medical Director review, including adverse determination and IRO referral pathways, so every case holds up under scrutiny.
  • Hit productivity, quality, and turnaround targets: Meet established standards, take part in quality activities like inter-rater reliability (IRRA), and apply feedback to keep us audit-ready for URAC, NCQA, and other applicable standards.
  • Protect member privacy at every step: Follow HIPAA and minimum-necessary standards, and complete required annual training and testing on time.
  • Cross-train and cover where the team needs you: Step in to support team operations and service-level commitments, and contribute to staff training as appropriate.

  • Minimum 1-2 years of recent clinical experience in acute care, med-surg, ICU/ED, or another relevant setting
  • Prior utilization review or utilization management experience preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Ability to interpret medical records and apply evidence-based criteria and plan medical policies
  • Working knowledge of clinical guidelines such as MCG and NCCN, and UM documentation systems
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams, with the ability to learn additional tools as assigned
  • Comfort working across multiple screens and a headset-based phone system, with proficient typing and accurate data entry
  • Ability to use remote-work technology (e.g., VPN) and departmental platforms (e.g., SharePoint/Drives) in line with security policies

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Paid Time Off—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $25-$30 per hour, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a talented Systems Architect, SME to join our Defense Development Team to lead the development of differentiated, technically credible, and executable solutions for a complex Federal Government program. This role can work remote.

The Systems Architect, SME will serve as a senior technical and strategic advisor working closely with delivery leadership and executive stakeholders to translate requirements into compelling solutions designed to perform against evaluation criteria and deliver measurable customer outcomes.

As part of a collaborative, high-impact integrated product development team, you’ll work on next-generation development incorporating AI/ML capabilities hosted on AWS Cloud infrastructure. This is your chance to help shape innovative solutions with the cutting-edge technology that makes a real difference for our customers’ missions.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience leading large-scale Federal technology programs, enterprise modernization, cloud solutions, software engineering programs with the executive presence to engage directly with senior government customers and internal leadership. The ideal candidate also provides expertise in Navy weapon systems/platforms.

Key Technologies and Skills:

  • MOSA & Modern Architecture: software architecture supporting extensibility, open interfaces, and integration across multiple systems.
  • AI/ML Integration: creating force multiplying capabilities applied to the development lifecycle and customer use cases.
  • Cloud-Native Development: AWS cloud architecture, services, and integration patterns.
  • Modern Service Design: RESTful APIs, event-driven architectures, microservices, and container orchestration.
  • Automation & Delivery: Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and distribution.
  • Distributed Systems Engineering: Building fault-tolerant, concurrent, high-throughput services with modern languages and tools.
  • Security by Design: Cloud security principles, compliance frameworks (RMF, FedRAMP), and Zero Trust patterns.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Clearance: active Secret security clearance is required.
  • Education: Minimum of 16 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 14 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 10 years with Ph.D.
  • Ten (10) or more years of directly related experience in software engineering; including requirements analysis, software development, installation, integration, evaluation, enhancement, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • At least three (3) years of experience in software integration and software testing, to include developing and implementing test plans and test scripts.
  • A minimum of four (4) years of experience developing software with one or more modern programming languages relevant to cloud-native services (e.g., Python, Go, Java, TypeScript).
  • Agile development experience using Scrum or SAFe Agile methodologies.
  • Experience developing modern information management applications with complex workflows, intuitive interfaces, and highly concurrent operation.
  • Proficiency with modern web service patterns (e.g. REST, JSON, HTTPs APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger) and frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, React, TailWind).
  • Strong executive presence, written communication, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated technical writing skills and shall have generated technical documents in support of a software development project.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Background working with the US Navy and NAVAIR.
  • Experience building fault-tolerant distributed systems over unreliable networks.
  • Applied use of Large Language Models (LLM), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) within customer use cases and solutions.
  • Applied use of AI-assisted coding within a software engineering lifecycle.
  • Proficiency in lifecycle automation including Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security compliance, deployment, and continuous monitoring.
  • Expertise with microservices software development techniques and container-orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of security and compliance best practices, RMF, and Zero Trust.
  • Expertise in Cloud Architecture design and development for Amazon AWS or Microsoft Azure.
  • At least three (3) years developing software on UNIX/Linux, with strong Linux fundamentals and proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash).

raw.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

A successful candidate will have experience in U.S., EMEA, APAC, LATAM and Canada benefit programs.

Benefits Strategy and Design:

  • Evaluate existing benefit plans and propose enhancements or changes based on market trends, cost-effectiveness, and employee needs.

Program Implementation and Management:

Compliance and Regulatory Adherence:

  • Certification in benefits (e.g., CEBS, CBP) is advantageous.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Performs quality checks to maintain the integrity of events and criteria for reporting purposes.
  • Processes members’ electronic documents, proof of data for inaccuracies, and any other missing information.
  • Resolves discrepancies identified using standard procedures and/or returning incomplete documents to their respective departments for correction and resolution.
  • Responds to, monitors, and manages State Secure File transfer inbox; tracking incoming packages and document requests; retrieving and securely transmitting requested PCSP and authorization documentation; completing the monthly disenrollment PCSP transfer process; monitoring and tracking turnaround times to support timely completion of requests
  • Facilitates manual mailings for other departments.
  • Maintain enrollment nodes, member demographics, and Person-Centered Service Plan (PCSP) details. Conduct data quality reviews by researching and analyzing member records across UAS, internal systems, and source documentation to identify, reconcile, and resolve enrollment, demographic, PCSP, and other data discrepancies.
  • Manage documentation pulls for State and regulatory requests, internal audits, and legal inquiries. Research member records across applicable systems to identify, retrieve, review, validate, organize, and prepare accurate and complete clinical documentation ensuring requested records meet established submission timeframe.
  • Support the assignment and reassignment of members to the appropriate Primary Care Manager by reviewing member and case information to determine appropriate care manager alignment based on established assignment criteria, program requirements, and team capacity. Research and resolve assignment discrepancies, process updates timely, and coordinate with applicable stakeholders to maintain accurate caseloads and continuity of care.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

  • Proficiency in navigating & working across multiple electronic documentation, healthcare, and database systems simultaneously.
  • Experience working with electronic medical records (EMR), protected health information (PHI), or any related healthcare documentation systems.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel which includes data entry and editing, search functions, formulas, sorting and filtering, formatting, and using existing pivot tables to research and analyze information.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and follow tasks through to completion.
  • Strong research and problem-solving skills, including the ability to navigate online resources and multiple systems to locate, validate, and reconcile information.

raw.description:
In this role, you will lead the explanation, configuration, validation, and best-practice adoption of PROS AI solutions during sales engagements, customer implementations, and strategic initiatives. You will work closely with Research Science, Machine Learning Engineering, Professional Services, Sales and Product Management teams to ensure customers realize maximum value from PROS solutions while influencing and contributing to future product innovation through field insights and customer needs.


Day in the Life of the Lead Applied Scientist:


Scientific Leadership & Customer Enablement

  • Validate and operationalize research outcomes by assessing model performance, business impact, usability, robustness, and customer adoption across real-world implementations.
  • Act as the scientific lead for high-impact sales and implementation engagements.
  • Guide customers and internal stakeholders on best practices for configuring and applying PROS AI solutions to solve complex business problems.
  • Communicate complex machine learning, optimization, forecasting, pricing, and revenue management concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Confidently address advanced customer questions regarding solution design, methodology, model outputs, and business impact.

Solution Design & Applied Analytics

  • Perform advanced analyses across multiple PROS AI solutions to identify opportunities for customer value creation.
  • Recommend solution configurations tailored to unique customer objectives and industry use cases.
  • Develop analytical frameworks, dashboards, and tools that support implementation, adoption, and business decision-making.
  • Validate solution behavior, explain results, and ensure scientific rigor throughout implementations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Research Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to refine existing solutions and influence future science capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Professional Services, and Sales teams to translate customer challenges into actionable product and science enhancements.
  • Help define training programs, implementation methodologies, and best practices that enable broader self-service adoption across teams.

Mentorship & Thought Leadership

  • Provide mentorship in AI Research team and scientific guidance across the organization.
  • Contribute to internal and external thought leadership through customer presentations, blogs, training materials, webinars, conferences, and industry events.
  • Represent PROS at customer-facing events, conferences, and strategic industry engagements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce implementation effort, shorten time-to-value, and improve customer outcomes associated with science solutions.

Required Qualifications - About you:

  • Master's degree (PhD preferred) in Operations Research, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or related quantitative field.
  • 10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, forecasting, optimization, machine learning, offer optimization, or related decision science disciplines.
  • Expertise in statistical modeling, machine learning, and applied AI techniques.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and Databricks.
  • Experience working directly with customers, implementations, or consulting engagements.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to explain advanced scientific concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and strategic decision-making.

Highly Preferred:

  • Experience with pricing, revenue management, forecasting, recommendation systems, or offer optimization.
  • Experience with multiple AI solution areas such as forecasting, optimization, machine learning, and generative AI.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning, recommendation systems, LLM applications, or agentic AI workflows.
  • Experience working in enterprise software.
  • Experience developing analytical dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau or Databricks.
  • Previous consulting, implementation, customer-success, solution architecture, or technical advisory experience.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership through conference presentations, publications, blogs, training programs, or industry engagement.

Why Join PROS?

PROS culture and its extraordinary people are at the core of our success. We are passionate about what we do and relentless in delivering on our promises.

Our commitment to customer success inspires us to think smarter and dream bigger, empowering airlines to achieve more than they ever imagined through intelligent offer and revenue optimization.

At PROS, we foster a culture of care, where people feel supported to grow, innovate, and bring their best selves to work—every day. From flexible ways of working to continuous learning, we empower our teams to thrive both personally and professionally.

Join PROS, a dedicated travel technology company with nearly 40 years of proven airline expertise and a long runway for future growth, now powering the future of AI-driven airline retailing. If you want to be part of something exceptional, help us shape how airlines compete, innovate, and win.

PROS Core Values

  • We are Owners

We look for every opportunity to create a better PROS and a better experience for our customers – and we hold ourselves accountable.

  • We are Innovators

We think creatively to find new paths to success – for our people, our customers and our business.

  • We Care

We are centered on caring for the people, businesses, and communities we serve.

raw.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Purchasing Specialist to support the day-to-day purchasing operations of a company operating in the marine spare parts industry.

The successful candidate will be responsible for processing requests for quotations (RFQs), sourcing spare parts and materials, coordinating with suppliers, comparing quotations, monitoring orders and deliveries, and maintaining accurate purchasing records within the company's ERP system.

This role requires strong communication skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple purchasing activities in a fast-paced environment. Candidates with previous experience in marine purchasing or the shipping industry will have an advantage, although applicants from other purchasing backgrounds who demonstrate strong adaptability and learning capabilities are also encouraged to apply.

Job Details:

  • Work Set-up: Work-from-Home
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Netherlands Time | 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM Manila Time
  • Holidays: PH Holidays

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process incoming requests for quotations (RFQs) and source spare parts, equipment, and materials based on purchasing requirements.
  • Request, review, and compare supplier quotations, considering pricing, availability, specifications, and delivery lead times.
  • Communicate with local and international suppliers to obtain quotations, clarify requirements, and follow up on outstanding requests.
  • Coordinate and monitor purchasing orders, ensuring timely processing, order expediting, and delivery tracking.
  • Proactively follow up with suppliers regarding order status, delivery schedules, and potential delays.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date purchasing information, supplier records, product details, and transaction data within the company's ERP system.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness when entering purchasing information, updating records, and processing documentation.
  • Coordinate closely with the sales and purchasing teams to support daily purchasing requirements and resolve supplier or order-related concerns.
  • Manage multiple RFQs, supplier communications, and purchasing activities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
  • Identify and promptly communicate discrepancies, order delays, or other purchasing-related issues to the appropriate team members.
  • Learn and effectively utilize the company's purchasing systems, internal procedures, and operational workflows.

Required Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in purchasing, operational procurement, buying, or a similar role involving supplier coordination and purchasing administration.
  • Hands-on experience processing RFQs, requesting and comparing supplier quotations, and following up on purchase orders or deliveries.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with international suppliers and colleagues.
  • Excellent organizational, administrative, and time management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling product information, quotations, specifications, and data entry.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Proficiency in using computers and business applications, with the ability to learn new ERP systems and purchasing software quickly.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setup while maintaining effective communication and coordination with the team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous purchasing experience in the marine, maritime, or shipping industry, particularly involving marine spare parts and vessel-related supplies.
  • Familiarity with purchasing operations in engineering, industrial equipment, technical supplies, or spare parts environments.
  • Experience working with ERP or purchasing management systems.
  • Familiarity with technical product descriptions, part numbers, supplier catalogs, and equipment specifications.
  • Experience coordinating with international suppliers and supporting geographically distributed teams.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.

We’re a data company helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.

And we’re an innovation company accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values:

Driven Waybuilders. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.

Relentless Curiosity. We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.

Smart Risk-Taking. We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.

Fearless Ownership. We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.

We’re Looking For:

We’re hiring AI-first Software Engineers (iOS) to build, evolve, and scale OPENLANE’s digital marketplace mobile experiences.

These roles are for engineers who already treat AI as a first-class development tool, not a novelty. You’ll use AI to move faster, ship higher-quality software, and reduce operational and development toil, while still applying strong engineering judgment, ownership, and systems thinking.

You’ll work on customer-facing wholesale marketplace apps, partnering closely with Product, Senior iOS engineers, Android, and backend teams.


AI is an accelerator. Engineering ownership still matters.


Why OPENLANE:

  • Work on real-time, high-value marketplace systems at scale
  • Be part of a major platform modernization and AI transformation
  • Use AI as a first-class development tool—not an experiment
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers, product leaders, and platform teams
  • Grow in an environment that values learning, ownership, and impact

You Are:

  • AI-forward. You already use AI tools to enhance development speed, quality, and efficiency, and you continuously adapt as tooling evolves.
  • Product-minded. You think beyond code and understand how technical decisions impact customers and business outcomes.
  • Ownership-driven. You take responsibility for systems end-to-end, including reliability and operational health.
  • Technically curious. You enjoy learning new technologies and thoughtfully evaluating emerging approaches.
  • Quality-focused. You value clean, maintainable code, strong testing practices, and production-ready engineering standards.

You Bring:

Core Engineering Skills

  • Experience shipping production iOS features in a team codebase
  • Solid Swift and SwiftUI skills; willingness to navigate UIKit where it still exists
  • Comfort with CI, tests, and code review
  • Growing end-to-end ownership of features with guidance from Senior engineers

AI-First Mindset

  • Actively uses AI development tools (code copilots, AI debuggers, test generators)
  • Curious about applying AI to real customer and business problems
  • Able to critically evaluate AI outputs instead of blindly accepting them
  • Comfortable learning and adapting in a fast-changing tool landscape

Technical Experience

  • Swift; SwiftUI views and ViewModels
  • Basic networking and app architecture (MVVM or similar)
  • Familiarity with feature flags and mobile analytics
  • Unit and/or UI testing
  • Willingness to grow snapshot testing

You Will:

  • Implement iOS features primarily in modern SwiftUI across seller and buyer marketplace experiences
  • Ship flag-gated work; write unit/UI tests; meet dual-OS PR gate expectations with support
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate coding, tests, and debugging—then verify before merge
  • Collaborate with Product/design; learn shared platform concerns under Senior guidance
  • Pair with Android counterparts on shared product behavior

How You’ll Use AI in This Role:

  • AI-assisted coding and refactoring
  • AI-generated test coverage and validation
  • AI-supported debugging and root-cause analysis
  • AI-assisted documentation and knowledge sharing
  • Applying AI tools to reduce repetitive work and increase engineering leverage

Who You Will Work With:

Reporting to an Engineering Manager (Mobile), this role collaborates closely with Product Managers, designers, backend and platform engineers, QA, Senior iOS engineers, and the sibling Android mobile team on a daily basis.


Must Have’s:

  • 3+ years professional iOS development (or equivalent depth)
  • Proficiency in Swift
  • Experience building apps with SwiftUI
  • Experience shipping at least one App Store app
  • AI-first mindset and active use of AI development tools with critical evaluation of outputs
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have’s:

  • Snapshot testing experience
  • Exposure to SPM modules and shared UI component libraries
  • Marketplace / e-commerce mobile experience
  • Interest in growing into auth, flags, and analytics ownership over time
  • Familiarity with hybrid WebView surfaces

What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)

  • Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

  • Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)

  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)

  • Robust Employee Assistance Program

  • Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer

  • Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs

  • Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization

  • Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement

Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

Compensation Range of

Annual Salary: $85,000.00 - $125,000.00 USD

(Depending on experience, skill set, qualifications, and other relevant factors.)

raw.excerpt: DescriptionCapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients.
raw.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Database Administrator with deep hands on expertise in MySQL, InnoDB, AWS RDS, and Amazon Aurora MySQL to join a sprint based Database Reliability Engineering (DBRE) team.

This is not a traditional ticket driven DBA role. You’ll help evolve database operations into a reliability first, automation driven, self service platform, independently troubleshooting complex production issues, executing recovery under pressure, and automating manual work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and optimize MySQL/InnoDB databases on AWS RDS and Aurora MySQL, including provisioning, scaling, patching, upgrades, and decommissioning
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues such as slow queries, replication lag, locking, deadlocks, and resource contention
  • Tune performance through execution plan analysis, query and index optimization, and InnoDB configuration
  • Design and maintain backup, restore, PITR, and disaster recovery procedures that meet defined RTOs and RPOs
  • Support high availability using Aurora clusters, Multi AZ, read replicas, and automated failover
  • Monitor health, performance, and capacity using CloudWatch and Performance Insights/Database Insights, and recommend right sizing
  • Automate DBA operations and build self service capabilities using Python, Bash, SQL, AWS CLI, and Infrastructure as Code where applicable
  • Implement secure, least privilege configurations (IAM, encryption, credential management) and support audits and compliance
  • Participate in on call and incident response, including root cause analysis
  • Collaborate in an Agile/Scrum team and maintain runbooks, documentation, and database standards

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in Database Administration, Database Engineering, or Database Reliability Engineering
  • Extensive hands on MySQL experience with deep knowledge of InnoDB internals (transactions, locking, deadlocks, buffer pool, redo/undo logs, crash recovery)
  • Strong hands on experience administering MySQL on AWS RDS and/or Aurora MySQL
  • Proven performance tuning, query optimization, and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong experience with backups, restores, PITR, disaster recovery, and high availability (Multi AZ, read replicas, Aurora failover)
  • Hands on experience with CloudWatch and Performance Insights/Database Insights
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, SQL, AWS CLI, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of AWS security (IAM, encryption, access controls)
  • Experience in Agile teams, with strong communication and documentation skills
  • Preferred: Terraform or CloudFormation; AWS Lambda, Systems Manager, or EventBridge; PostgreSQL; Kubernetes/EKS; CI/CD; regulated environments; AWS cost optimization; building self service database platforms

Benefits

  • Join Our Dynamic Team: Experience our fun, inclusive, innovative culture that values your unique contributions and supports your professional growth.
  • Embrace the Opportunities: Seize daily chances to learn, innovate, and excel. Make a real impact in your field.
  • Limitless Career Growth: Unlock a world of possibilities and resources to propel your career forward.
  • Fast-Paced Thrills: Thrive in a high-energy, engaging atmosphere. Embrace challenges and reap stimulating rewards.
  • Flexibility, Your Way: Embrace the freedom to work from home or any location of your choice. Create your ideal work environment.
  • Work-Life Balance at Its Best: Say goodbye to stressful commutes and hello to quality time with loved ones. Achieve a healthy work-life integration to perform at your best.

raw.description:
Position Title: Senior Software Engineer, IP4G

Position Location: Remote in the US

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Software Test Engineer with experience automating the testing of Openstack end-points. This will involve extending (or rewriting) an existing Elixir test harness and working with Software Engineers (SWEs) and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to determine test cases and priority. You’ll be automating smoke tests as part of the developer pipeline and running more comprehensive tests that run in parallel to ongoing development work. You’ll run tests against different versions of micro-services, looking for bugs and defects introduced in changes. These tests will also be running against production-like environments, to find the bugs before our customers find them. We have need for both testing our CLI/TUI as well as a GUI applications that our customers use to interact with our systems. This role will involve architecting and developing a rigorous test harness aimed at integration testing of multi-service API driven application.

Essential Functions:

  • Maintain and extend test harness to exercise automated and manual test steps.
  • Collaborate with SMEs to determine feature priority for testing.
  • Collaborate with SREs to incorporate test harness into appropriate CI/CD pipeline steps.
  • Collaborate with SWE.
  • Document test cases to help produce user facing documentation and FAQs.
  • Find and close gaps in our test coverage and delivery processes.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ethical and critical thinking.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Excellent sales and customer service skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
  • Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
  • Proficiency in programming languages.
  • Strong understanding of software development methodologies.

Education and Experience:
